WITH school_sat AS (
  SELECT
    cds,
    1.0 * NumGE1500 / NULLIF(NumTstTakr, 0) AS excellence_rate
  FROM satscores
  WHERE rtype = 'S'
),
school_free_rate AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    MAX(`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS free_rate
  FROM frpm
  GROUP BY CDSCode
)
SELECT MAX(f.free_rate) AS highest_ages_5_17_free_meal_eligibility_rate
FROM school_sat AS s
JOIN school_free_rate AS f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.excellence_rate > 0.3;

SELECT s.School, f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.GSserved LIKE 'K-9'

SELECT f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS percent_eligible_free_k12,
       f."District Code" AS district_code
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'
   OR s.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine'
   OR s.AdmFName3 = 'Alusine';

WITH requested(CDSCode) AS (
  VALUES ('1751010130583'), ('1612910137588'), ('1611760134270')
),
enrollments AS (
  SELECT
    r.CDSCode,
    (SELECT MAX(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
     FROM frpm AS f
     WHERE f.CDSCode = r.CDSCode) AS enrollment,
    (SELECT s.NCESSchool
     FROM schools AS s
     WHERE s.CDSCode = r.CDSCode
     LIMIT 1) AS nces_school_identification_number
  FROM requested AS r
),
highest AS (
  SELECT MAX(enrollment) AS max_enrollment
  FROM enrollments
)
SELECT nces_school_identification_number
FROM enrollments
WHERE enrollment = (SELECT max_enrollment FROM highest)
  AND nces_school_identification_number IS NOT NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(s.NumTstTakr, 0)), 2) AS avg_sat_test_takers_per_school
FROM schools AS sch
LEFT JOIN satscores AS s
  ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sch.CharterNum = '756'
  AND sch.MailCity = 'San Diego';

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT
    s.School,
    s.GSserved,
    CASE
      WHEN lower(trim(s.GSserved)) LIKE 'ps%'
        OR lower(trim(s.GSserved)) LIKE 'preschool%' THEN -2
      WHEN lower(trim(s.GSserved)) LIKE 'tk%'
        OR lower(trim(s.GSserved)) LIKE 'transitional kindergarten%' THEN -1
      WHEN lower(trim(s.GSserved)) LIKE 'k%'
        OR lower(trim(s.GSserved)) LIKE 'kindergarten%' THEN 0
      ELSE CAST(substr(trim(s.GSserved), 1, instr(trim(s.GSserved), '-') - 1) AS INTEGER)
    END AS start_grade
  FROM schools AS s
  WHERE s.NCESDist = '0613360'
    AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND s.SOC IN ('66', '68', '65', '63')
    AND s.GSserved IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(substr(s.GSserved, instr(s.GSserved, '-') + 1) AS INTEGER) = 12
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM satscores AS sat
      WHERE sat.cds = s.CDSCode
        AND sat.NumTstTakr > 0
    )
),
earliest AS (
  SELECT MIN(start_grade) AS min_grade
  FROM qualifying
)
SELECT q.School, q.GSserved AS grade_span_served
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN earliest AS e ON q.start_grade = e.min_grade
ORDER BY q.School;

SELECT s.School, s.MailStreet, s.MailCity, s.MailState, s.MailZip, ss.AvgScrRead
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS ss ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOCType = 'State Board of Education'
  AND ss.rtype = 'S'
  AND ss.AvgScrRead = (
    SELECT MAX(ss2.AvgScrRead)
    FROM schools AS s2
    JOIN satscores AS ss2 ON ss2.cds = s2.CDSCode
    WHERE s2.DOCType = 'State Board of Education'
      AND ss2.rtype = 'S'
      AND ss2.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT sc.School, sc.GSoffered, sc.FundingType, ss.AvgScrMath, ss.NumTstTakr
FROM schools AS sc
JOIN satscores AS ss ON ss.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.CDSCode = '1611190130609';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM satscores AS s
WHERE s.cname = 'Contra Costa'
  AND s.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.NumTstTakr > (
    SELECT NumTstTakr
    FROM satscores
    WHERE cds = '7618040730051'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) AS qualifying_school_count
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND s.MailCity = 'San Francisco'
  AND f."District Type" IN (
    'Unified School District',
    'High School District',
    'Elementary School District',
    'County Office of Education (COE)'
  )
  AND sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite >= 1500;

SELECT CASE WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN upper(GSserved) LIKE 'K-%' THEN 0 ELSE CAST(substr(GSserved, 1, instr(GSserved, '-') - 1) AS INTEGER) END) = 0 THEN 'Kindergarten' ELSE CAST(MIN(CAST(substr(GSserved, 1, instr(GSserved, '-') - 1) AS INTEGER)) AS TEXT) END AS lowest_grade_level
FROM schools
WHERE NCESDist = '0632640'
  AND GSserved IS NOT NULL
  AND instr(GSserved, '-') > 0;

SELECT ROUND(
    1.0 * SUM(COALESCE(f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)", 0)) / COUNT(*),
    2
)
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
   AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
WHERE s.SOCType = 'Youth Authority Facilities';

WITH state_board_schools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, School, AdmEmail1
  FROM schools
  WHERE DOCType = 'State Board of Education'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    s.School,
    s.AdmEmail1,
    sat.NumGE1500,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sat.NumGE1500 DESC) AS rnk
  FROM state_board_schools AS s
  JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE sat.rtype = 'S'
    AND sat.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT School, AdmEmail1, NumGE1500
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1;

WITH middle_schools AS (
  SELECT
    SOCType AS school_type,
    School AS school_name,
    Latitude AS latitude
  FROM schools
  WHERE Latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      lower(coalesce(SOCType, '')) LIKE '%middle%'
      OR lower(coalesce(SOCType, '')) LIKE '%junior high%'
      OR lower(coalesce(School, '')) LIKE '%middle%'
      OR lower(coalesce(School, '')) LIKE '%junior high%'
    )
)
SELECT school_type, school_name, latitude
FROM middle_schools
WHERE latitude = (SELECT MAX(latitude) FROM middle_schools);

WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT
    f.CDSCode,
    f."School Name" AS school_name,
    f."Low Grade" AS earliest_grade_level,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    CASE f."Low Grade"
      WHEN 'P' THEN 0 WHEN 'K' THEN 1
      WHEN '1' THEN 2 WHEN '2' THEN 3 WHEN '3' THEN 4
      WHEN '4' THEN 5 WHEN '5' THEN 6 WHEN '6' THEN 7
      WHEN '7' THEN 8 WHEN '8' THEN 9 WHEN '9' THEN 10
      WHEN '10' THEN 11 WHEN '11' THEN 12 WHEN '12' THEN 13
      ELSE -1
    END AS grade_order
  FROM frpm AS f
  JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  WHERE s.DOC = '31'
    AND s.SOC = '31'
    AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
)
SELECT
  c.school_name,
  c.earliest_grade_level,
  c.enrollment_k12,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT SUM(t.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS t WHERE t.cds = c.CDSCode),
    0
  ) AS sat_test_takers
FROM candidates AS c
WHERE c.grade_order >= 0
ORDER BY
  c.grade_order DESC,
  c.enrollment_k12 DESC,
  c.school_name COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH categories(funding_type, sort_order) AS (
  VALUES ('Directly funded', 1), ('Locally funded', 2)
),
latest_year AS (
  SELECT MAX("Academic Year") AS academic_year
  FROM frpm
),
schools_by_funding AS (
  SELECT
    f.CDSCode,
    f."Charter Funding Type" AS funding_type,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count,
    s.StatusType
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN latest_year y
    ON f."Academic Year" = y.academic_year
  JOIN schools s
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  WHERE f."District Type" = 'County Office of Education (COE)'
    AND f."School Type" = 'K-12 Schools (Public)'
    AND f."Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
)
SELECT
  c.funding_type,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN sbf.StatusType = 'Active' THEN 1 END) AS currently_operating_schools,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sbf.StatusType = 'Active' THEN sbf.enrollment ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_k12_enrollment,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sbf.StatusType = 'Active' THEN sbf.frpm_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_frpm_eligible_k12_students
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN schools_by_funding sbf
  ON sbf.funding_type = c.funding_type
GROUP BY c.funding_type, c.sort_order
ORDER BY c.sort_order;

WITH scores AS (
  SELECT
    sc.School AS school_name,
    sc.District AS district,
    sc.County AS county,
    sat.AvgScrWrite AS avg_sat_writing
  FROM schools AS sc
  JOIN satscores AS sat
    ON sat.cds = sc.CDSCode
  WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Closed'
    AND sat.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    school_name,
    district,
    county,
    avg_sat_writing,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_sat_writing DESC) AS score_rank
  FROM scores
)
SELECT school_name, district, county, avg_sat_writing
FROM ranked
WHERE score_rank = 2
ORDER BY school_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS schools_with_zero_sat_takers
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND s.State = 'CA'
  AND s.FundingType = 'Public'
  AND s.EILName = 'High School'
  AND (sat.cds IS NULL OR sat.NumTstTakr = 0);

WITH months AS (
  SELECT 1 AS month_num UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL
  SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL
  SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL
  SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12
),
monthly_openings AS (
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', OpenDate) AS INTEGER) AS month_num,
         COUNT(*) AS school_count
  FROM schools
  WHERE County = 'San Diego'
    AND DOCType IN ('District', 'School District')
    AND OpenDate >= '1980-01-01'
    AND OpenDate < '1981-01-01'
  GROUP BY CAST(strftime('%m', OpenDate) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(COALESCE(monthly_openings.school_count, 0)) AS REAL) / 12
       AS average_schools_per_month
FROM months
LEFT JOIN monthly_openings USING (month_num);

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.CDSCode, s.Virtual
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.State = 'CA'
    AND t.AvgScrMath > 400
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Virtual IN ('F', 'P') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
  1
) AS percentage
FROM eligible;

SELECT
  s.School AS school_name,
  s.County AS county,
  s.District AS district,
  s.City AS city,
  f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS k12_enrollment,
  f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS k12_frpm_eligible,
  f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS k12_frpm_eligible_percentage,
  sat.NumTstTakr AS sat_test_takers,
  sat.AvgScrRead AS average_reading_score,
  sat.AvgScrMath AS average_math_score,
  sat.AvgScrWrite AS average_writing_score,
  sat.NumGE1500 AS test_takers_total_score_at_least_1500
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = substr(s.CDSCode, 2)
WHERE s.CDSCode = '01612590137943';

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School,
    s.GSserved,
    s.Charter,
    f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 /
      NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS free_meal_rate
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
    AND s.GSserved LIKE '%12%'
    AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
),
scores AS (
  SELECT
    cds,
    CASE
      WHEN NumTstTakr = 0
        OR AvgScrRead IS NULL
        OR AvgScrMath IS NULL
        OR AvgScrWrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
      WHEN AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
      WHEN AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
      ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS performance_level
  FROM satscores
)
SELECT
  e.School AS school_name,
  printf('%.4f', e.free_meal_rate) AS free_meal_rate,
  CASE
    WHEN e.Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes'
    WHEN e.Charter = 0 THEN 'No'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS charter_school,
  e.GSserved AS grades_served,
  COALESCE(sc.performance_level, 'No SAT Data') AS sat_performance_level
FROM eligible AS e
LEFT JOIN scores AS sc ON sc.cds = e.CDSCode
WHERE e.free_meal_rate = (
  SELECT MAX(free_meal_rate)
  FROM eligible
);

WITH virtual_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, County, School
    FROM schools
    WHERE Virtual = 'F'
),
county_counts AS (
    SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS exclusively_virtual_school_count
    FROM virtual_schools
    GROUP BY County
),
ranked_counties AS (
    SELECT County,
           exclusively_virtual_school_count,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY exclusively_virtual_school_count DESC) AS county_rank
    FROM county_counts
),
virtual_reading_scores AS (
    SELECT v.County, v.School, MAX(s.AvgScrRead) AS AvgScrRead
    FROM virtual_schools v
    LEFT JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = v.CDSCode
    GROUP BY v.County, v.School
),
best_scores AS (
    SELECT County, MAX(AvgScrRead) AS highest_avg_reading_score
    FROM virtual_reading_scores
    GROUP BY County
)
SELECT rc.County AS county_name,
       rc.exclusively_virtual_school_count,
       CASE
           WHEN bs.highest_avg_reading_score IS NULL THEN 'None'
           ELSE vrs.School
       END AS school_name
FROM ranked_counties rc
LEFT JOIN best_scores bs ON bs.County = rc.County
LEFT JOIN virtual_reading_scores vrs
    ON vrs.County = rc.County
   AND vrs.AvgScrRead = bs.highest_avg_reading_score
WHERE rc.county_rank <= 5
ORDER BY rc.exclusively_virtual_school_count DESC, rc.County, school_name

WITH target AS (
  SELECT County
  FROM schools
  WHERE CDSCode = '1100170109835'
),
counties AS (
  SELECT 'Santa Barbara' AS County
  UNION
  SELECT County FROM target
)
SELECT
  c.County,
  COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS exclusive_virtual_schools
FROM counties AS c
LEFT JOIN schools AS s
  ON s.County = c.County
 AND s.Virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY c.County
ORDER BY exclusive_virtual_schools DESC, c.County ASC;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    f.CDSCode,
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.County AS county,
    s.City AS city,
    s.MailStreet AS mailing_street,
    s.MailCity AS mailing_city,
    s.MailState AS mailing_state,
    s.MailZip AS mailing_zip,
    s.Website AS website,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS k12_enrollment,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_eligible_count,
    1.0 * f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS frpm_share,
    sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite AS average_total_sat_score,
    100.0 * sat.NumGE1500 / NULLIF(sat.NumTstTakr, 0) AS pct_sat_takers_1500_plus,
    s.OpenDate AS opening_date,
    CASE WHEN s.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END AS status
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = f.CDSCode
  WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 100
    AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
    AND f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
    AND f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0
    AND s.Charter = 0
    AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND sat.rtype = 'S'
),
max_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(frpm_eligible_count) AS value FROM base
),
min_share AS (
  SELECT MIN(frpm_share) AS value FROM base
),
picked AS (
  SELECT 'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS part, b.*
  FROM base b
  JOIN max_count m ON b.frpm_eligible_count = m.value

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'smallest FRPM share', b.*
  FROM base b
  JOIN min_share m ON b.frpm_share = m.value

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'the CDS code from my notes', b.*
  FROM base b
  WHERE b.CDSCode = '4615150435602'
)
SELECT
  part,
  school_name,
  county,
  city,
  mailing_street,
  mailing_city,
  mailing_state,
  mailing_zip,
  website,
  k12_enrollment,
  frpm_eligible_count,
  frpm_share,
  average_total_sat_score,
  pct_sat_takers_1500_plus,
  opening_date,
  status
FROM picked
ORDER BY
  CASE part
    WHEN 'largest FRPM-eligible count' THEN 1
    WHEN 'smallest FRPM share' THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END,
  school_name;

SELECT
    f."School Name" AS school_name,
    s."Street" AS street_address
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
    ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  AND f."School Name" IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(f."School Name") <> ''
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" + 30
  AND (
      CASE UPPER(TRIM(f."High Grade"))
          WHEN 'K' THEN 0
          WHEN 'TK' THEN -1
          WHEN 'PK' THEN -2
          ELSE CAST(f."High Grade" AS INTEGER)
      END
  ) <= 8
ORDER BY f."School Name";

SELECT s.School AS school_name, s.Street AS street_address
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE CAST(f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS REAL) - CAST(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS REAL) > 30
  AND CAST(f."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) >= 9
ORDER BY f.CDSCode ASC;

SELECT
  frpm."County Name" AS county_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT frpm.CDSCode) AS qualifying_school_count
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores
  ON satscores.cds = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE frpm."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  AND frpm."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" > 0.1
  AND satscores.NumGE1500 > 0
GROUP BY frpm."County Name"
ORDER BY qualifying_school_count DESC, county_name ASC;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT County
  FROM schools
  WHERE CDSCode = '1611430131177'
),
school_counts AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.AdmFName1,
    s.AdmLName1,
    sat.NumGE1500
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN satscores AS sat
    ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
  JOIN target AS t
    ON s.County = t.County
  WHERE sat.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT CDSCode, AdmFName1, AdmLName1, NumGE1500
FROM school_counts
ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC, CDSCode ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT
    sc.CDSCode,
    sc.Street,
    sc.City,
    sc.Zip,
    sc.State,
    ss.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / ss.NumTstTakr AS excellence_rate
  FROM satscores AS ss
  JOIN schools AS sc ON sc.CDSCode = ss.cds
  WHERE ss.rtype = 'S'
    AND ss.NumTstTakr >= 700
    AND ss.NumTstTakr > 0
    AND ss.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT Street, City, Zip, State
FROM candidates
ORDER BY excellence_rate ASC, CAST(CDSCode AS INTEGER) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.City, COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) AS provision2_magnet_school_count
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
  AND s.City IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY provision2_magnet_school_count DESC, s.City;

WITH provision2_magnet AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.CDSCode, f.`County Name`
    FROM frpm AS f
    JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    WHERE f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Provision 2'
      AND (s.Magnet = 1 OR lower(s.School) LIKE '%magnet%')
),
county_totals AS (
    SELECT
        p.`County Name` AS county_name,
        SUM(COALESCE(ss.NumTstTakr, 0)) AS total_sat_test_takers
    FROM provision2_magnet AS p
    LEFT JOIN satscores AS ss ON ss.cds = p.CDSCode
    GROUP BY p.`County Name`
)
SELECT county_name, total_sat_test_takers
FROM county_totals;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS distinct_card_printings
FROM cards AS c
WHERE (c.power IS NULL OR TRIM(c.power) = '' OR c.power GLOB '*[*]*')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM rulings AS r
    WHERE r.uuid = c.uuid
      AND LOWER(r.text) LIKE '%triggered ability%'
  );

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT c.uuid
  FROM cards AS c
  WHERE c.power IS NULL
     OR c.power GLOB '*[*]*'
),
french_translations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.uuid
  FROM foreign_data AS f
  WHERE lower(f.language) = 'french'
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ft.uuid IS NOT NULL THEN e.uuid END)
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT e.uuid), 0),
  2
) AS percentage_with_french_translation
FROM eligible AS e
LEFT JOIN french_translations AS ft ON ft.uuid = e.uuid;

SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)) AS span_years
FROM cards
WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'
  AND frameVersion GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS count
FROM cards c
WHERE c.borderColor = 'black'
  AND c.availability LIKE '%mtgo%'
  AND c.power IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(c.power AS REAL) >= 10
  AND c.type LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND c.setCode NOT IN (
    SELECT s.code
    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.isFoilOnly = 1
  )

WITH translation_counts AS (
  SELECT setCode, COUNT(DISTINCT translation) AS translation_count
  FROM set_translations
  WHERE translation IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY setCode
),
qualifying_sets AS (
  SELECT s.code
  FROM sets AS s
  LEFT JOIN translation_counts AS t
    ON t.setCode = s.code
  WHERE COALESCE(t.translation_count, 0) < 5
),
card_counts AS (
  SELECT setCode, COUNT(*) AS card_count
  FROM cards
  GROUP BY setCode
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cc.card_count, 0)), 0) AS total_cards
FROM qualifying_sets AS qs
LEFT JOIN card_counts AS cc
  ON cc.setCode = qs.code;

WITH localized_sets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.code, s.type
  FROM sets AS s
  JOIN set_translations AS st
    ON st.setCode = s.code
  WHERE st.translation IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(st.translation) <> ''
),
localized_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ls.type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ls.code) AS translated_set_count,
    COUNT(c.uuid) AS card_count
  FROM localized_sets AS ls
  LEFT JOIN cards AS c
    ON c.setCode = ls.code
  GROUP BY ls.type
)
SELECT
  s.type AS set_type,
  COALESCE(lc.translated_set_count, 0) AS translated_set_count,
  COALESCE(lc.card_count, 0) AS card_count
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT type FROM sets) AS s
LEFT JOIN localized_counts AS lc
  ON lc.type = s.type
ORDER BY s.type COLLATE NOCASE;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS ruling_count
FROM rulings r
JOIN cards c ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Mishra''s Factory'
  AND r.date = (
    SELECT MAX(r2.date)
    FROM rulings r2
    JOIN cards c2 ON c2.uuid = r2.uuid
    WHERE c2.name = 'Mishra''s Factory'
  );

WITH creature_cards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT artist, scryfallOracleId
  FROM cards
  WHERE artist IS NOT NULL
    AND scryfallOracleId IS NOT NULL
    AND instr(',' || replace(types, ' ', '') || ',', ',Creature,') > 0
),
artist_counts AS (
  SELECT artist, COUNT(*) AS creature_card_count
  FROM creature_cards
  GROUP BY artist
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT artist, creature_card_count,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY creature_card_count DESC) AS rank
  FROM artist_counts
)
SELECT artist, creature_card_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rank = 1
ORDER BY artist;

WITH newest AS (
  SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)) AS newest_frame
  FROM cards
  WHERE convertedManaCost = 0
    AND frameVersion IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT c.frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN newest AS n
  ON CAST(c.frameVersion AS INTEGER) = n.newest_frame
GROUP BY c.frameVersion
ORDER BY c.frameVersion;

WITH tarmogoyf_printings AS (
  SELECT c.setCode, c.frameVersion, s.releaseDate
  FROM cards AS c
  LEFT JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
  WHERE c.name = 'Tarmogoyf'
),
frame_totals AS (
  SELECT
    frameVersion,
    COUNT(*) AS printing_count,
    MAX(CAST(substr(releaseDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) AS latest_year
  FROM tarmogoyf_printings
  GROUP BY frameVersion
)
SELECT
  frameVersion,
  latest_year AS year,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * printing_count /
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tarmogoyf_printings),
    2
  ) AS percentage_of_all_printings
FROM frame_totals
WHERE latest_year = (SELECT MAX(latest_year) FROM frame_totals);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.manaCost = '{0}'
  AND l.format = 'commander'
  AND l.status = 'Legal';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE keywords LIKE '%Flying%'
  AND keywords LIKE '%Cycling%';

WITH target_sets AS (
  SELECT s.code, s.name
  FROM sets AS s
  WHERE s.code IN (
    (
      SELECT s1.code
      FROM cards AS c
      JOIN sets AS s1 ON s1.code = c.setCode
      WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
      ORDER BY s1.releaseDate ASC, s1.code ASC
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    (
      SELECT s2.code
      FROM sets AS s2
      ORDER BY s2.releaseDate DESC, s2.code ASC
      LIMIT 1
    )
  )
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    ts.code,
    ts.name,
    COUNT(c.uuid) AS total_cards,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN c.manaCost IS NOT NULL
         AND c.manaCost <> ''
         AND c.convertedManaCost <= 3
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS qualifying_cards
  FROM target_sets AS ts
  LEFT JOIN cards AS c ON c.setCode = ts.code
  GROUP BY ts.code, ts.name
)
SELECT
  name AS set_name,
  ROUND(100.0 * qualifying_cards / NULLIF(total_cards, 0), 2) AS percentage
FROM stats
ORDER BY code;

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    uuid,
    name,
    number,
    CAST(number AS INTEGER) AS collector_num
  FROM cards
  WHERE LOWER(watermark) = 'abzan'
),
max_num AS (
  SELECT MAX(collector_num) AS max_collector_num
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  r.name,
  r.number AS collector_number,
  COUNT(fd.id) AS foreign_language_printings
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN max_num AS m
  ON r.collector_num = m.max_collector_num
LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS fd
  ON fd.uuid = r.uuid
GROUP BY r.uuid, r.name, r.number
ORDER BY r.name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'white'
  AND power IS NOT NULL
  AND power <> '*'
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) < 3;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT c.name, c.convertedManaCost
  FROM cards c
  JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
  WHERE s.name = 'Dark Ascension'
    AND c.keywords LIKE '%Flash%'
),
highest AS (
  SELECT MAX(convertedManaCost) AS cmc
  FROM target
)
SELECT name
FROM target
WHERE convertedManaCost = (SELECT cmc FROM highest)
ORDER BY name;

SELECT s.name, s.keyruneCode, COUNT(DISTINCT st.language) AS language_count
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.keyruneCode
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.name;

WITH qualifying_sets AS (
  SELECT s.code
  FROM sets AS s
  WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2017-01-01'
    AND s.releaseDate < '2018-01-01'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM set_translations AS st
      WHERE st.setCode = s.code
        AND st.language IS NOT NULL
        AND lower(st.language) <> 'english'
        AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cards
FROM cards AS c
JOIN qualifying_sets AS qs ON qs.code = c.setCode;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT artist
  FROM cards
  WHERE borderColor = 'black'
    AND availability LIKE '%arena%'
    AND power GLOB '[0-9]*'
    AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 10
    AND artist IS NOT NULL
),
counts AS (
  SELECT artist, COUNT(*) AS card_count
  FROM eligible
  GROUP BY artist
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT artist, card_count,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY card_count DESC) AS rank
  FROM counts
)
SELECT artist, card_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rank = 1
ORDER BY artist;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE hasContentWarning = 1
  AND availability LIKE '%paper%'
  AND (availability NOT LIKE '%mtgo%' OR mtgoId IS NULL);

SELECT s.type AS expansion_type, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN st.language = 'Japanese' THEN s.id END) AS japanese_name_set_count
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st
  ON st.setCode = s.code
  AND st.language = 'Japanese'
GROUP BY s.type
ORDER BY s.type ASC;

WITH eligible_cards AS (
  SELECT artist
  FROM cards
  WHERE artist IS NOT NULL
    AND trim(artist) <> ''
    AND borderColor = 'black'
    AND availability LIKE '%arena%'
    AND availability NOT LIKE '%mtgo%'
    AND power IS NOT NULL
    AND trim(power) <> ''
    AND power NOT LIKE '%*%'
    AND power NOT LIKE '%?%'
    AND power NOT LIKE '%½%'
    AND CAST(power AS REAL) >= 5
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT artist) AS artist_count
FROM eligible_cards;

WITH anchor_sets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.releaseDate
  FROM cards AS c
  JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
  WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'
),
latest_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(releaseDate) AS releaseDate
  FROM anchor_sets
),
target_sets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.code
  FROM cards AS c
  JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
  JOIN latest_date AS ld ON s.releaseDate = ld.releaseDate
  WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN target_sets AS ts ON ts.code = c.setCode
WHERE c.types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND c.power GLOB '[0-9]*'
  AND c.toughness GLOB '[0-9]*'
  AND CAST(c.power AS REAL) > CAST(c.toughness AS REAL);

WITH per_oracle AS (
  SELECT
    scryfallOracleId,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_regular,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomFoilId <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_foil,
    MAX(CASE WHEN leadershipSkills LIKE '%commander%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS commander_leadable,
    MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)) AS frame_year
  FROM cards
  WHERE scryfallOracleId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY scryfallOracleId
),
qualified AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM per_oracle
  WHERE has_regular = 1
    AND has_foil = 1
    AND commander_leadable = 1
),
latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(frame_year) AS frame_year
  FROM qualified
)
SELECT latest.frame_year, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM qualified
JOIN latest ON qualified.frame_year = latest.frame_year
GROUP BY latest.frame_year;

SELECT c.name, COUNT(r.id) AS official_rulings_total
FROM cards AS c
LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Fireball'
GROUP BY c.name;

WITH card_ruling_counts AS (
    SELECT c.name AS card_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS ruling_count
    FROM cards AS c
    JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
    WHERE c.originalType = 'Creature - Elf'
    GROUP BY c.name
)
SELECT card_name, ruling_count
FROM card_ruling_counts
WHERE ruling_count = (SELECT MAX(ruling_count) FROM card_ruling_counts)
ORDER BY card_name;

WITH card_colors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.uuid, c.colors AS color
  FROM cards AS c
  WHERE c.id BETWEEN 1 AND 20
    AND c.colors IN ('W', 'B')
),
legal_color_formats AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cc.color, l.format
  FROM card_colors AS cc
  JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = cc.uuid
  WHERE l.status = 'Legal'
)
SELECT CASE color WHEN 'W' THEN 'white' WHEN 'B' THEN 'black' END AS card_color,
       COUNT(format) AS legal_play_formats
FROM legal_color_formats
GROUP BY color
ORDER BY color;

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT frameVersion
  FROM cards
  WHERE artist = 'John Avon'
    AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
    AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
    AND frameVersion IS NOT NULL
),
latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)) AS year
  FROM qualifying
)
SELECT CAST(q.frameVersion AS INTEGER) AS frame_year, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM qualifying q
JOIN latest l ON CAST(q.frameVersion AS INTEGER) = l.year
GROUP BY CAST(q.frameVersion AS INTEGER)
ORDER BY frame_year;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS printing_count
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.artist = 'Erica Yang'
  AND l.format = 'pauper'
  AND l.status = 'Legal'
  AND c.availability LIKE '%paper%';

SELECT name, cardKingdomFoilId, cardKingdomId
FROM cards
WHERE types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomFoilId <> ''
  AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomId <> ''
ORDER BY CAST(cardKingdomFoilId AS INTEGER), CAST(cardKingdomId AS INTEGER)
LIMIT 3;

WITH guild_counts AS (
  SELECT
    c.watermark AS guild,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS cards_with_other_language
  FROM cards AS c
  WHERE LOWER(c.watermark) IN (
    'azorius', 'boros', 'dimir', 'golgari', 'gruul',
    'izzet', 'orzhov', 'rakdos', 'selesnya', 'simic'
  )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM foreign_data AS fd
      WHERE fd.uuid = c.uuid
        AND fd.language IS NOT NULL
        AND LOWER(fd.language) <> 'english'
    )
  GROUP BY c.watermark
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    guild,
    cards_with_other_language,
    MAX(cards_with_other_language) OVER () AS max_count
  FROM guild_counts
)
SELECT guild, cards_with_other_language
FROM ranked
WHERE cards_with_other_language = max_count
ORDER BY guild;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT scryfallOracleId) AS count_cards
FROM cards
WHERE text IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(text) <> ''
  AND CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) >= 2015;

WITH latest_frame AS (
  SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)) AS frame_year
  FROM cards
)
SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM cards AS c
CROSS JOIN latest_frame AS lf
WHERE c.isPromo = 1
  AND c.otherFaceIds IS NOT NULL
  AND c.otherFaceIds <> ''
  AND CAST(c.frameVersion AS INTEGER) = lf.frame_year
ORDER BY c.name;

WITH tarmogoyf_reprints AS (
  SELECT
    s.name AS set_name,
    s.releaseDate AS release_date,
    CAST(c.frameVersion AS INTEGER) AS frame_year,
    CAST(substr(s.releaseDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS release_year
  FROM cards AS c
  JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
  WHERE c.name = 'Tarmogoyf'
    AND c.isReprint = 1
)
SELECT set_name, release_date
FROM tarmogoyf_reprints
WHERE release_year - frame_year >= 10
ORDER BY release_date, set_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS printing_count
FROM (
  SELECT c.uuid
  FROM cards AS c
  JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
  JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
  WHERE c.name = 'Counterspell'
    AND fd.language IN ('French', 'Italian')
    AND s.isForeignOnly = 1
  GROUP BY c.uuid, c.setCode, c.number
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fd.language) = 2
);

SELECT s.name, s.releaseDate
FROM sets AS s
WHERE s.type = (
    SELECT type
    FROM sets
    WHERE name = 'From the Vault: Lore'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM set_translations AS t
    WHERE t.setCode = s.code
      AND t.translation IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(t.translation) <> ''
)
ORDER BY s.releaseDate ASC;

WITH aven AS (
  SELECT c.setCode, c.frameVersion
  FROM cards AS c
  WHERE c.name = 'Aven Mindcensor'
),
newest AS (
  SELECT MAX(frameVersion) AS frameVersion
  FROM aven
)
SELECT s.name, s.releaseDate
FROM aven AS a
JOIN newest AS n ON a.frameVersion = n.frameVersion
JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = a.setCode
WHERE s.releaseDate = (
  SELECT MAX(s2.releaseDate)
  FROM aven AS a2
  JOIN newest AS n2 ON a2.frameVersion = n2.frameVersion
  JOIN sets AS s2 ON s2.code = a2.setCode
)
GROUP BY s.name, s.releaseDate
ORDER BY s.name;

SELECT s.code, s.releaseDate
FROM sets AS s
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM set_translations AS st
    WHERE st.setCode = s.code
      AND st.language = 'Spanish'
      AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.code;

SELECT SUM(convertedManaCost) AS total_converted_mana_cost
FROM cards
WHERE artist = 'Rob Alexander'
  AND originalReleaseDate >= '2013-01-01'
  AND originalReleaseDate < '2014-01-01'
  AND originalReleaseDate IS NOT NULL;

WITH per_set AS (
  SELECT
    s.id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT st.language) AS language_count
  FROM sets AS s
  LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st
    ON st.setCode = s.code
  WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2016-01-01'
    AND s.releaseDate < '2017-01-01'
  GROUP BY s.id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(language_count), 2) AS average_languages
FROM per_set;

WITH target_cards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    fd.name AS japanese_name,
    c.type AS english_card_type,
    c.uuid AS card_uuid
  FROM cards AS c
  JOIN foreign_data AS fd
    ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
  WHERE c.watermark = 'boros'
    AND fd.language = 'Japanese'
)
SELECT
  tc.japanese_name,
  tc.english_card_type,
  COUNT(r.id) AS ruling_total
FROM target_cards AS tc
LEFT JOIN rulings AS r
  ON r.uuid = tc.card_uuid
GROUP BY tc.japanese_name, tc.english_card_type
ORDER BY tc.japanese_name, tc.english_card_type;

WITH translated_languages AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT language
    FROM set_translations
    WHERE language IS NOT NULL
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        tl.language,
        COUNT(DISTINCT fd.uuid) AS printing_count
    FROM translated_languages AS tl
    LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS fd
        ON fd.language = tl.language
       AND fd.flavorText IS NOT NULL
       AND TRIM(fd.flavorText) <> ''
    GROUP BY tl.language
)
SELECT language, printing_count
FROM counts
WHERE printing_count = (SELECT MIN(printing_count) FROM counts)
ORDER BY language;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS count
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE st.language = 'French'
  AND c.types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND c.power NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
  AND CAST(c.power AS INTEGER) >= 10;

WITH banned_creatures AS (
  SELECT c.uuid, MAX(c.convertedManaCost) AS mana_value
  FROM cards c
  JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
  WHERE c.edhrecRank BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
    AND c.type LIKE '%Creature%'
    AND l.status = 'Banned'
  GROUP BY c.uuid
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(mana_value), 1) AS average_mana_value
FROM banned_creatures;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_printings
FROM cards
WHERE power IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) > 3
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) <= 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS printing_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE c.originalReleaseDate >= '2014-01-01'
  AND c.originalReleaseDate < '2015-01-01'
  AND s.mtgoCode IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.mtgoCode) <> '';

WITH eligible_languages AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT language
  FROM set_translations
  WHERE language IS NOT NULL
    AND lower(language) <> 'phyrexian'
),
counts AS (
  SELECT fd.language, COUNT(*) AS printing_count
  FROM foreign_data AS fd
  JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
  WHERE fd.language IN (SELECT language FROM eligible_languages)
  GROUP BY fd.language
)
SELECT language, printing_count
FROM counts
WHERE printing_count = (SELECT MIN(printing_count) FROM counts)
ORDER BY language;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS italian_rules_text_printings
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM foreign_data f
    WHERE f.uuid = c.uuid
      AND lower(f.language) = 'italian'
      AND f.text IS NOT NULL
      AND trim(f.text) <> ''
  );

WITH commander_sets AS (
  SELECT
    s.id,
    s.name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS total_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fd.language) AS official_language_count
  FROM sets AS s
  LEFT JOIN cards AS c
    ON c.setCode = s.code
   AND COALESCE(c.isOnlineOnly, 0) = 0
  LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS fd
    ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
  WHERE s.type = 'commander'
    AND s.releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
    AND s.releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
  GROUP BY s.id, s.name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         MAX(total_card_count) OVER () AS max_card_count
  FROM commander_sets
)
SELECT id, name, total_card_count, official_language_count
FROM ranked
WHERE total_card_count = max_card_count
ORDER BY id ASC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fd.language) AS foreign_language_count
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Swamp'
  AND fd.language IS NOT NULL
  AND fd.language <> 'English';

SELECT SUM(u.Reputation) AS combined_reputation
FROM users AS u
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%United Kingdom%'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.Age), 2) AS average_user_age
FROM comments AS c
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = c.UserId
WHERE c.Text LIKE '%http://%';

WITH organizer AS (
  SELECT b.UserId, b.Date AS organizer_date
  FROM badges b
  WHERE b.Name = 'Organizer'
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT o.UserId
  FROM organizer o
  JOIN users u ON u.Id = o.UserId
  WHERE u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
    AND (
      SELECT COUNT(*)
      FROM badges b2
      WHERE b2.UserId = o.UserId
        AND b2.Date < o.organizer_date
    ) >= 5
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) AS count
FROM qualifying;

WITH first_posts AS (
  SELECT OwnerUserId, MIN(CreaionDate) AS first_post_date
  FROM posts
  WHERE OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY OwnerUserId
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS users_first_posted_in_2010_and_located_in_india
FROM first_posts AS fp
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = fp.OwnerUserId
WHERE fp.first_post_date >= '2010-01-01'
  AND fp.first_post_date < '2011-01-01'
  AND TRIM(u.Location) = 'India';

SELECT CAST(ROUND(AVG(u.Reputation)) AS INTEGER) AS average_reputation
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.Score < 20
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM tags AS t
    WHERE t.TagName = 'r'
      AND p.Tags LIKE '%<' || t.TagName || '>%'
  );

WITH posts_2012 AS (
    SELECT Id, Score, LastEditorUserId
    FROM posts
    WHERE CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
      AND CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
),
germany_editors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.Id, u.Reputation
    FROM posts_2012 AS p
    JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
    WHERE u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.Id IS NOT NULL THEN p.Score ELSE 0 END), 0)
        AS germany_last_editor_posts_total_score,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.Id IS NULL THEN p.Score ELSE 0 END), 0)
        AS other_posts_total_score,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM germany_editors)
        AS germany_based_last_editors_count,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(Reputation), 0) FROM germany_editors)
        AS combined_reputation
FROM posts_2012 AS p
LEFT JOIN users AS u
    ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
   AND u.Location LIKE '%Germany%';

SELECT SUM(u.Reputation) AS combined_reputation
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%'
  AND p.LasActivityDate >= '2014-08-27'
  AND p.LasActivityDate < '2014-08-28';

SELECT SUM(linking.Score) AS total_score
FROM posts AS target
JOIN postLinks AS links ON links.RelatedPostId = target.Id
JOIN posts AS linking ON linking.Id = links.PostId
WHERE target.Title = 'A Probability distribution value exceeding 1 is OK?'
  AND linking.Tags LIKE '%<r>%';

WITH badge_totals AS (
  SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName, COUNT(b.Id) AS badge_total
  FROM users AS u
  LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id
  WHERE u.Location = 'Germany'
  GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
),
ranked_totals AS (
  SELECT badge_total,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY badge_total DESC) AS total_rank
  FROM badge_totals
)
SELECT bt.DisplayName, bt.badge_total
FROM badge_totals AS bt
WHERE bt.badge_total = (
  SELECT badge_total
  FROM ranked_totals
  WHERE total_rank = 2
  LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY bt.DisplayName;

WITH california_users AS (
  SELECT Id, DisplayName, Views, Reputation
  FROM users
  WHERE Location LIKE '%California%'
     OR Location LIKE '%CA%'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    Id,
    DisplayName,
    Views,
    Reputation,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Views DESC) AS view_rank
  FROM california_users
)
SELECT Id, DisplayName, Views, Reputation
FROM ranked
WHERE view_rank = 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.Id) AS user_count
FROM users AS u
JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%India%'
  AND b.Name = 'Yearling'
  AND b.Date < '2014-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.DisplayName) AS distinct_display_names
FROM badges AS b
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE b.Name = 'Supporter'
  AND u.Age BETWEEN 19 AND 65;

WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT p.Id, p.Title
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p.Title LIKE '%principal component scores%'
),
counts AS (

    LEFT JOIN postLinks AS pl ON pl.PostId = c.Id
    GROUP BY c.Id, c.Title

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(CAST(p.OwnerUserId AS TEXT), p.OwnerDisplayName)) AS users_count
FROM votes AS v
JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = v.PostId
WHERE v.BountyAmount >= 30
  AND v.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01'
  AND v.CreationDate < '2011-01-01'
  AND COALESCE(CAST(p.OwnerUserId AS TEXT), p.OwnerDisplayName) IS NOT NULL;

WITH prolific AS (
  SELECT OwnerUserId
  FROM posts
  WHERE CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
    AND CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
    AND OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY OwnerUserId
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
),
vote_totals AS (
  SELECT UserId, COUNT(*) AS up_votes_cast
  FROM votes

)
SELECT

  ROUND(AVG(u.Age), 2) AS avg_age
FROM prolific p

LEFT JOIN vote_totals v ON v.UserId = p.OwnerUserId;

WITH RECURSIVE months(month_start) AS (
  SELECT '2010-01-01'

  SELECT date(month_start, '+1 month')
  FROM months
  WHERE month_start < '2010-12-01'
),
monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT
    m.month_start,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.AnswerCount <= 2 THEN pl.PostId END) AS posts_linked
  FROM months AS m
  LEFT JOIN postLinks AS pl
    ON pl.CreationDate >= m.month_start
   AND pl.CreationDate < date(m.month_start, '+1 month')
  LEFT JOIN posts AS p
    ON p.Id = pl.PostId
  GROUP BY m.month_start
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(posts_linked), 2) AS average_posts_per_month
FROM monthly_counts;

WITH qualifying_posts AS (
  SELECT p.Id, p.OwnerUserId
  FROM posts AS p
  WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2010-01-01'
    AND p.CreaionDate < '2011-01-01'
    AND p.Score > 5
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.Reputation < 1000 OR u.Id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
  2
) AS percentage_not_high_reputation
FROM qualifying_posts AS p
LEFT JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId;

WITH target_post AS (
  SELECT Id
  FROM posts
  WHERE Title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'
),
editor_events AS (
  SELECT
    ph.UserId,
    ph.UserDisplayName,
    COUNT(*) AS edit_comment_count
  FROM postHistory AS ph
  JOIN target_post AS tp ON tp.Id = ph.PostId
  WHERE ph.PostHistoryTypeId = 5
    AND ph.Comment IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(ph.Comment) <> ''
  GROUP BY ph.UserId, ph.UserDisplayName
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(e.UserDisplayName), ''), u.DisplayName, '(unknown)') AS editor_display_name,
  e.edit_comment_count
FROM editor_events AS e
LEFT JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = e.UserId
ORDER BY e.edit_comment_count DESC, editor_display_name;

WITH customer_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    CustomerID,
    SUM(Amount * Price) AS total_consumption
  FROM transactions_1k
  WHERE Date >= '2012-01-01'
    AND Date < '2013-01-01'
  GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT
  c.Segment AS client_segment,
  COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customer_consumption AS cc
JOIN customers AS c
  ON c.CustomerID = cc.CustomerID
WHERE cc.total_consumption < 30000
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY c.Segment;

SELECT c.Segment AS client_segment,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS customers_consumed_fuel_2013
FROM customers AS c
JOIN transactions_1k AS t
  ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date >= '2013-01-01'
  AND t.Date < '2014-01-01'
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY c.Segment;

WITH quarterly AS (
  SELECT
    CustomerID,
    SUM(Consumption) AS quarter_consumption
  FROM yearmonth
  WHERE Date >= '201304' AND Date <= '201306'
  GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT
  c.Currency,
  ROUND(AVG(q.quarter_consumption), 2) AS avg_quarter_consumption
FROM quarterly AS q
JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = q.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency IN ('EUR', 'CZK')
GROUP BY c.Currency
ORDER BY c.Currency;

WITH customer_consumption AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Currency, SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS consumption_2012
  FROM customers c
  JOIN transactions_1k t ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE t.Date >= '2012-01-01' AND t.Date < '2013-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Currency
),
currency_averages AS (
  SELECT Currency, AVG(consumption_2012) AS avg_consumption
  FROM customer_consumption
  GROUP BY Currency
)
SELECT ROUND(
  MAX(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN avg_consumption END) -
  MAX(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN avg_consumption END)
) AS difference
FROM currency_averages;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM (
  SELECT t.CustomerID
  FROM transactions_1k AS t
  JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM'
    AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND t.Date >= '2013-01-01'
    AND t.Date < '2014-01-01'
  GROUP BY t.CustomerID
  HAVING SUM(t.Amount) > 1000000
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS count_sme_customers
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
JOIN products p ON p.ProductID = t.ProductID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
  AND t.Date >= '2013-02-01'
  AND t.Date < '2013-03-01'
  AND LOWER(p.Description) LIKE '%gas%'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM Match AS m
JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = m.home_player_3
WHERE p.height > 180;

WITH eligible AS (

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ever_high) / COUNT(*), 2) AS high_percentage

WITH ranked AS (

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY player_api_id
      ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC

)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2) AS average_height_cm

WITH risky_teams AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT team_api_id
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Risky'
),
short_name_counts AS (
    SELECT t.team_short_name,
           COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_api_id) AS club_count
    FROM Team AS t
    JOIN risky_teams AS r
      ON r.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    GROUP BY t.team_short_name
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_api_id) > 1
),
ranked_attributes AS (
    SELECT ta.team_api_id,
           ta.chanceCreationPassing,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY ta.team_api_id
               ORDER BY ABS(julianday(ta.date) - julianday('2014-09-19')),
                        CASE
                            WHEN julianday(ta.date) <= julianday('2014-09-19') THEN 0
                            ELSE 1
                        END,
                        ta.date DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM Team_Attributes AS ta
    JOIN risky_teams AS r
      ON r.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
    WHERE date(ta.date) <= date('2014-09-19')
)
SELECT s.team_short_name AS short_name,
       s.club_count,
       ROUND(AVG(a.chanceCreationPassing), 1) AS average_chance_creation_passing_risk

JOIN Team AS t
  ON t.team_short_name = s.team_short_name
JOIN ranked_attributes AS a
  ON a.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
 AND a.rn = 1
GROUP BY s.team_short_name, s.club_count
ORDER BY average_chance_creation_passing_risk DESC,
         short_name ASC;

current_medium AS (

SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2) AS average_height_cm

WITH left_footed AS (

WITH qualifying_players AS (

),
appearances AS (

SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.match_id) AS matches_played

GROUP BY p.id, p.player_name

WITH home_wins AS (
    SELECT
        m.id AS match_id,

SELECT

    t.team_short_name AS short_name,

  ON t.team_api_id = rw.team_api_id
GROUP BY t.id, t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name

unique_players AS (

SELECT season AS season_label,

WITH ranked_ratings AS (

    pa.volleys,

      PARTITION BY pa.player_api_id
      ORDER BY pa.date DESC, pa.id DESC

 AND rr.rn = 1

WITH player_totals AS (

  WHERE home_player_3 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY home_player_3
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_home_goals), 2) AS average_total_home_goals_per_player

    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_1 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_9 FROM Match

counts AS (

    GROUP BY c.id, c.name

SELECT country, player_count

      PARTITION BY player_api_id

)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    player_api_id,
    preferred_foot,

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY player_api_id
      ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
    ) AS rn

current_records AS (

  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
    AND preferred_foot = 'left'
    AND attacking_work_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(attacking_work_rate) <> ''

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE jumping >= 80
  AND date >= '2007-02-22'
  AND date < '2007-08-31';

WITH target_team AS (
  SELECT team_api_id
  FROM Team
  WHERE team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
),
last_match AS (
  SELECT date
  FROM Match
  WHERE season = '2012/2013'

  UNION ALL
  SELECT date
  FROM Match
  WHERE season = '2012/2013'
    AND away_team_api_id IN (SELECT team_api_id FROM target_team)
),
final_date AS (

)
SELECT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass

WHERE ta.date = (
  SELECT MAX(ta2.date)
