SELECT
  d.A2 AS district_name,
  ROUND(100.0 * (d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12, 2) AS unemployment_percentage_change
FROM district AS d
WHERE d.A12 IS NOT NULL
  AND d.A13 IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id
      AND l.status = 'D'
  )
ORDER BY d.A2;

WITH first_month AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', MIN(date)) AS month
  FROM account
),
opened_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
  FROM account AS a
  JOIN first_month AS f
    ON strftime('%Y-%m', a.date) = f.month
)
SELECT d.district_id, d.A2 AS district, d.A4 AS inhabitants
FROM district AS d
JOIN opened_districts AS o
  ON o.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A4 = (
  SELECT MAX(d2.A4)
  FROM district AS d2
  JOIN opened_districts AS o2
    ON o2.district_id = d2.district_id
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
  AND (t.k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM(t.k_symbol) = '');

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT
    d.A3 AS region,
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_approved_amount
  FROM loan AS l
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE date(l.date) <= date('1995-12-31')
    AND date(l.date, '+' || l.duration || ' months', '-1 day') >= date('1995-12-31')
  GROUP BY d.A3
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    region,
    total_approved_amount,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_approved_amount DESC) AS rnk
  FROM qualifying
)
SELECT region, total_approved_amount
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1;

WITH eligible_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
  FROM account AS a
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE d.A3 = 'north Bohemia'
    AND a.date <= '1995-12-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ea.account_id) AS count
FROM eligible_accounts AS ea
JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = ea.account_id
WHERE t.bank = 'AB';

WITH eligible_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.A13 AS average_salary
  FROM district AS d
  JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
  WHERE d.A3 = 'East Bohemia'
    AND CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(average_salary), 2) AS average_of_district_average_salaries,
       COUNT(*) AS district_count
FROM eligible_districts;

WITH target_clients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.district_id
  FROM client c
  JOIN disp owner_disp ON owner_disp.client_id = c.client_id
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = owner_disp.account_id
  JOIN district client_district ON client_district.district_id = c.district_id
  WHERE owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
    AND client_district.A3 = 'central Bohemia'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM card ca
      JOIN disp any_disp ON any_disp.disp_id = ca.disp_id
      WHERE any_disp.account_id = a.account_id
    )
),
district_means AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT tc.district_id, d.A11 AS average_salary
  FROM target_clients tc
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = tc.district_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(average_salary), 2) AS avg_of_district_average_salaries
FROM district_means;

WITH eligible_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
  FROM account AS a
  JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
    AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
),
loan_counts AS (
  SELECT ea.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count
  FROM eligible_accounts AS ea
  LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = ea.account_id
  GROUP BY ea.account_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(loan_count), 2) AS average_loans_per_account
FROM loan_counts;

WITH borrowing_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.date AS opening_date,
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_borrowed
  FROM account AS a
  JOIN loan AS l
    ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district AS branch_district
    ON branch_district.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE branch_district.A2 = 'Prachatice'
  GROUP BY a.account_id, a.date
),
owners AS (
  SELECT
    b.account_id,
    b.opening_date,
    b.total_borrowed,
    c.district_id AS home_district_id
  FROM borrowing_accounts AS b
  JOIN disp AS dp
    ON dp.account_id = b.account_id
   AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client AS c
    ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
),
counterparty_counts AS (
  SELECT
    t.account_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.bank || ':' || CAST(t.account AS TEXT)) AS counterparty_count
  FROM trans AS t
  WHERE t.operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU')
    AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
    AND t.account IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.account_id
)
SELECT
  o.account_id AS account_number,
  o.opening_date,
  o.total_borrowed,
  COALESCE(cc.counterparty_count, 0) AS outside_bank_counterparties,
  hd.A2 AS home_district,
  hd.A4 AS home_district_population,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY hd.A4 DESC) AS population_rank
FROM owners AS o
JOIN district AS hd
  ON hd.district_id = o.home_district_id
LEFT JOIN counterparty_counts AS cc
  ON cc.account_id = o.account_id
ORDER BY hd.A4 DESC, o.account_id ASC;

WITH account_avg AS (
  SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
qualifying_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    cl.gender,
    a.district_id,
    d.A4 AS inhabitants,
    d.A11 AS average_salary,
    d.A10 AS urban_ratio
  FROM card c
  JOIN disp dp
    ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id
   AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client cl ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
  JOIN account_avg aa ON aa.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE c.type = 'gold'
    AND aa.avg_balance > 1000
    AND d.A4 > 100000
),
district_stats AS (
  SELECT
    gender,
    COUNT(*) AS district_count,
    MAX(inhabitants) AS max_inhabitants,
    AVG(average_salary) AS avg_salary,
    AVG(urban_ratio) AS avg_urban_ratio
  FROM qualifying_districts
  GROUP BY gender
)
SELECT
  ds.gender,
  ds.district_count,
  qd.district_id AS top_district_id,
  ds.max_inhabitants AS top_district_inhabitants,
  ROUND(ds.avg_salary, 2) AS avg_salary,
  ROUND(ds.avg_urban_ratio, 2) AS avg_urban_ratio
FROM district_stats ds
JOIN qualifying_districts qd
  ON qd.gender = ds.gender
 AND qd.inhabitants = ds.max_inhabitants
ORDER BY CASE ds.gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
         qd.district_id;

WITH pair_totals AS (
  SELECT
    t.bank AS recipient_bank_code,
    t.account AS recipient_counter_account_number,
    COUNT(*) AS outgoing_payment_count,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount_paid
  FROM trans AS t
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE t.date >= '1998-01-01'
    AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
    AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    AND d.A4 >= 250000
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM disp AS owner_disp
      JOIN card AS c ON c.disp_id = owner_disp.disp_id
      WHERE owner_disp.account_id = a.account_id
        AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
        AND c.type = 'gold'
    )
  GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC) AS amount_rank
  FROM pair_totals
)
SELECT
  recipient_bank_code,
  recipient_counter_account_number,
  outgoing_payment_count,
  total_amount_paid
FROM ranked
WHERE amount_rank = 1
ORDER BY recipient_bank_code, recipient_counter_account_number;

WITH outgoing_purposed AS (
  SELECT t.amount, t.k_symbol
  FROM trans AS t
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek'
    AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    AND t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(t.k_symbol) <> ''
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
  / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0),
  2
) AS percentage
FROM outgoing_purposed;

WITH qualified AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, a.district_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp dp
      ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
     AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN account a
      ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    JOIN district d
      ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM card ca
          WHERE ca.disp_id = dp.disp_id
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM loan l
          WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id
      )
),
district_averages AS (
    SELECT q.region,
           ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS avg_salary,
           ROUND(AVG(d.A12), 2) AS avg_unemployment_1996
    FROM qualified q
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = q.district_id
    GROUP BY q.region
),
candidate_districts AS (
    SELECT q.region,
           d.A2 AS district_name,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY q.region
               ORDER BY d.A8 DESC, d.A2 ASC
           ) AS rn
    FROM qualified q
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = q.district_id
    GROUP BY q.region, d.district_id, d.A2, d.A8
)
SELECT da.region,
       da.avg_salary,
       da.avg_unemployment_1996,
       cd.district_name AS most_populous_district
FROM district_averages da
JOIN candidate_districts cd
  ON cd.region = da.region
 AND cd.rn = 1
ORDER BY da.region;

WITH holders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.type, cl.district_id
  FROM card c
  JOIN disp dp ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id
  JOIN client cl ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id
  WHERE lower(c.type) IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    h.type,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A4 AS inhabitants,
    MIN(d.A4) OVER (PARTITION BY h.type) AS min_inhabitants
  FROM holders h
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = h.district_id
)
SELECT
  type AS card_type,
  district_name AS home_district,
  inhabitants
FROM ranked
WHERE inhabitants = min_inhabitants
ORDER BY card_type, home_district;

WITH target_region AS (
  SELECT A3 AS region
  FROM district
  WHERE A2 = 'Litomerice'
),
opened_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  JOIN target_region r ON d.A3 = r.region
  WHERE a.date >= '1996-01-01'
    AND a.date < '1997-01-01'
),
ranked_transactions AS (
  SELECT oa.account_id,
         oa.district_id,
         t.balance,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY oa.account_id
           ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM opened_accounts oa
  JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = oa.account_id
  WHERE t.date < '1997-01-01'
),
account_balances AS (
  SELECT oa.account_id, oa.district_id, rt.balance
  FROM opened_accounts oa
  LEFT JOIN ranked_transactions rt
    ON rt.account_id = oa.account_id
   AND rt.rn = 1
),
district_stats AS (
  SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
         COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_1996,
         AVG(ab.balance) AS raw_average
  FROM account_balances ab
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = ab.district_id
  GROUP BY ab.district_id, d.A2
),
ranked_districts AS (
  SELECT district_name,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           ORDER BY raw_average DESC, district_name ASC
         ) AS district_rank
  FROM district_stats
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(balance) AS raw_region_average
  FROM account_balances
)
SELECT ds.district_name,
       ds.accounts_opened_1996,
       ROUND(ds.raw_average, 2) AS average_end_1996_balance,
       ROUND(rs.raw_region_average, 2) AS region_average_end_1996_balance,
       CASE WHEN rd.district_rank = 1 THEN ds.district_name END
         AS highest_average_district
FROM district_stats ds
JOIN ranked_districts rd ON rd.district_name = ds.district_name
CROSS JOIN region_stats rs
ORDER BY ds.district_name;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
  SELECT
    l.loan_id,
    a.district_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.loan_id ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM loan AS l
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  WHERE l.duration = 24
    AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
top_ten_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT district_id
  FROM ranked_loans
  WHERE rn <= 10
),
district_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.district_id,
    d.A4 AS inhabitants,
    d.A11 AS average_salary
  FROM district AS d
  JOIN top_ten_districts AS t ON t.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT
  district_id,
  inhabitants,
  ROUND(AVG(average_salary) OVER (), 2) AS average_salary_across_top_loan_districts
FROM district_stats
ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A3 AS region,
        d.A4 AS population
    FROM district AS d
    WHERE d.A4 >= 100000
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM account AS a
          JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
          WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id
            AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      )
),
withdrawals AS (
    SELECT
        a.district_id,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
standing_orders AS (
    SELECT
        a.district_id,
        SUM(o.amount) AS total_standing_order_debit
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
district_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        q.district_id,
        q.district_name,
        q.region,
        q.population,
        w.total_withdrawn,
        1.0 * w.total_withdrawn / q.population AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
        COALESCE(so.total_standing_order_debit, 0) AS total_standing_order_debit,
        COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
    FROM qualifying_districts AS q
    JOIN withdrawals AS w ON w.district_id = q.district_id
    JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = q.district_id
    LEFT JOIN standing_orders AS so ON so.district_id = q.district_id
    GROUP BY
        q.district_id,
        q.district_name,
        q.region,
        q.population,
        w.total_withdrawn,
        so.total_standing_order_debit
)
SELECT
    district_name,
    region,
    population,
    total_withdrawn,
    ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS withdrawal_pressure_rank,
    ROUND(total_standing_order_debit / account_count, 2) AS average_standing_order_debit_per_account
FROM district_metrics
ORDER BY withdrawal_pressure_rank, district_name;

WITH client_home AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE client_id = 3541
),
accessible_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        a.account_id,
        a.date AS opened_date,
        a.frequency,
        a.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A3 AS region,
        d.A11 AS average_salary,
        CASE WHEN a.district_id = ch.district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_home_district,
        COALESCE(l.status, 'none') AS loan_repayment_status,
        COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount
    FROM disp AS p
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = p.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    CROSS JOIN client_home AS ch
    LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE p.client_id = 3541
),
transaction_totals AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_income,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_expense
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
regional_client_counts AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
),
district_population_ranks AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        A3 AS region,
        A2 AS district_name,
        A4 AS inhabitants,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY A3 ORDER BY A4 DESC) AS population_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A3 ORDER BY A4 DESC, district_id) AS population_position
    FROM district
),
region_max_populations AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        district_name AS most_populous_district,
        inhabitants AS most_populous_district_inhabitants
    FROM district_population_ranks
    WHERE population_position = 1
)
SELECT
    aa.account_id,
    aa.opened_date,
    aa.frequency,
    aa.district_name,
    aa.region,
    aa.is_home_district,
    aa.average_salary,
    aa.loan_repayment_status,
    aa.loan_amount,
    COALESCE(tt.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    COALESCE(tt.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE(tt.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
    COALESCE(tt.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(tt.total_expense, 0) AS net_balance,
    rcc.client_count AS clients_with_home_district_in_region,
    rmp.most_populous_district,
    rmp.most_populous_district_inhabitants,
    dpr.population_rank AS account_district_population_rank
FROM accessible_accounts AS aa
LEFT JOIN transaction_totals AS tt ON tt.account_id = aa.account_id
JOIN regional_client_counts AS rcc ON rcc.region = aa.region
JOIN region_max_populations AS rmp ON rmp.region = aa.region
JOIN district_population_ranks AS dpr ON dpr.district_id = aa.district_id
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, aa.account_id ASC;

WITH account_lending AS (
  SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.district_id,
    strftime('%Y', a.date) AS opening_year,
    COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS amount_lent
  FROM account AS a
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE d.A3 = 'Central Bohemia'
    AND a.date >= '1996-01-01'
  GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, strftime('%Y', a.date)
),
district_year AS (
  SELECT
    opening_year,
    district_id,
    SUM(amount_lent) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS lent_per_account
  FROM account_lending
  GROUP BY opening_year, district_id
)
SELECT
  al.opening_year AS opening_year,
  COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened,
  SUM(al.amount_lent) AS total_amount_lent,
  ROUND(AVG(dy.lent_per_account), 2) AS average_district_lent_per_account
FROM account_lending AS al
JOIN district_year AS dy
  ON dy.opening_year = al.opening_year
 AND dy.district_id = al.district_id
GROUP BY al.opening_year
ORDER BY al.opening_year;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
  SELECT
    l.loan_id,
    l.account_id,
    l.amount AS approved_amount,
    l.date AS approval_date,
    a.district_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.date ASC, l.loan_id ASC
    ) AS loan_rank
  FROM loan AS l
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  WHERE l.duration = 24
    AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
selected_loans AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM ranked_loans
  WHERE loan_rank <= 10
),
latest_balances AS (
  SELECT
    s.loan_id,
    t.balance,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY s.loan_id
      ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    ) AS transaction_rank
  FROM selected_loans AS s
  JOIN trans AS t
    ON t.account_id = s.account_id
   AND date(t.date) = date(s.approval_date)
)
SELECT
  s.loan_id,
  d.A2 AS branch_district,
  s.approved_amount,
  s.approval_date,
  b.balance AS end_of_approval_day_balance
FROM selected_loans AS s
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = s.district_id
LEFT JOIN latest_balances AS b
  ON b.loan_id = s.loan_id
 AND b.transaction_rank = 1
ORDER BY s.approved_amount DESC, s.approval_date ASC, s.loan_id ASC;

SELECT d.A2 AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM district AS d
JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE lower(d.A3) LIKE '%north moravia%'
  AND date(t.date) <= date('1998-10-14')
  AND t.k_symbol IS NULL
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH applicant_account AS (
  SELECT account_id
  FROM loan
  WHERE loan_id = 98832
)
SELECT
  t.bank AS bank_code,
  t.account AS account_number,
  COUNT(*) AS outgoing_payment_count,
  SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount_paid
FROM trans AS t
JOIN applicant_account AS aa
  ON aa.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date < '1996-01-03'
GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC;

SELECT SUM(CASE
             WHEN k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN amount
             WHEN k_symbol = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -amount
             ELSE 0
           END) AS net_interest_czk
FROM trans
WHERE account_id = 2335
  AND date >= '1998-01-01'
  AND date < '1999-01-01'
  AND k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK');

WITH female_loans AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        l.account_id,
        l.amount,
        l.duration,
        l.payments,
        l.status,
        c.client_id,
        c.birth_date,
        a.district_id AS branch_district_id
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) AS amount_rank
    FROM female_loans
),
account_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
region_loans AS (
    SELECT
        d.A3 AS region,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_in_region
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
),
region_salary AS (
    SELECT
        A3 AS region,
        ROUND(AVG(A11), 2) AS avg_district_salary
    FROM district
    GROUP BY A3
)
SELECT
    r.client_id,
    r.amount AS loan_amount,
    r.duration AS duration_months,
    ROUND(r.payments * r.duration, 2) AS total_payments,
    ROUND(r.payments * r.duration - r.amount, 2) AS interest_paid,
    r.status AS loan_status,
    d.A2 AS district,
    d.A3 AS region,
    COALESCE(t.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(t.total_deposits, 0), 2) AS total_deposits,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(t.total_deposits, 0) > 2 * r.amount THEN 'High Income'
        WHEN COALESCE(t.total_deposits, 0) > r.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
        ELSE 'Low Income'
    END AS income_category,
    rl.loans_in_region,
    rs.avg_district_salary,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', r.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
      - CASE
            WHEN strftime('%m-%d', r.birth_date) > '10-09' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS age_on_2026_10_09
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = r.branch_district_id
LEFT JOIN account_transactions AS t ON t.account_id = r.account_id
JOIN region_loans AS rl ON rl.region = d.A3
JOIN region_salary AS rs ON rs.region = d.A3
WHERE r.amount_rank <= 3
ORDER BY r.amount DESC, r.loan_id;

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, d.A11 AS salary
  FROM district d
  WHERE d.A4 >= 100000
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM account a
      WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id
        AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
        AND a.date >= '1997-01-01'
        AND a.date < '1998-01-01'
    )
)
SELECT
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM account a
    JOIN qualifying_districts q ON q.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
      AND a.date >= '1997-01-01'
      AND a.date < '1998-01-01'
  ) AS total_accounts,
  COUNT(*) AS district_count,
  ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS average_salary
FROM qualifying_districts;

WITH gold_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM card AS c
    JOIN disp AS d ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE lower(c.type) = 'gold'
),
transaction_totals AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_amount_received,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_amount_withdrawn,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN t.bank IS NOT NULL
             AND trim(t.bank) <> ''
             AND t.account IS NOT NULL
            THEN t.bank || ':' || CAST(t.account AS TEXT)
        END) AS external_counterparty_count
    FROM trans AS t
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
account_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ga.account_id,
        a.district_id,
        COALESCE(tt.total_amount_received, 0) AS total_amount_received,
        COALESCE(tt.total_amount_withdrawn, 0) AS total_amount_withdrawn,
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM loan AS l
            WHERE l.account_id = ga.account_id
        ) AS loan_count,
        COALESCE(tt.external_counterparty_count, 0) AS external_counterparty_count
    FROM gold_accounts AS ga
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = ga.account_id
    LEFT JOIN transaction_totals AS tt ON tt.account_id = ga.account_id
)
SELECT
    s.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS region,
    s.total_amount_received,
    s.total_amount_withdrawn,
    s.loan_count,
    s.external_counterparty_count,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.external_counterparty_count DESC) AS counterparty_rank
FROM account_stats AS s
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = s.district_id
ORDER BY counterparty_rank, s.account_id;

WITH eligible_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
           a.account_id,
           a.district_id
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN disp AS owner_disp
      ON owner_disp.account_id = a.account_id
     AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN card AS c
      ON c.disp_id = owner_disp.disp_id
     AND c.type = 'classic'
),
client_counts AS (
    SELECT district_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS client_count
    FROM eligible_accounts
    GROUP BY district_id
),
payment_totals AS (
    SELECT ea.district_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT t.bank || ':' || t.account) AS external_account_count,
           SUM(t.amount) AS outgoing_amount
    FROM eligible_accounts AS ea
    JOIN trans AS t
      ON t.account_id = ea.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
      AND t.account IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ea.district_id
)
SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
       COALESCE(cc.client_count, 0) AS client_count,
       COALESCE(pt.external_account_count, 0) AS external_account_count,
       COALESCE(pt.outgoing_amount, 0) AS outgoing_amount
FROM district AS d
LEFT JOIN client_counts AS cc
  ON cc.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN payment_totals AS pt
  ON pt.district_id = d.district_id
ORDER BY outgoing_amount DESC, district_name ASC;

WITH target_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
  FROM client AS c
  JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'F'
    AND c.birth_date < '1930-01-01'
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS average_salary
FROM target_districts AS t
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = t.district_id;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS average_district_salary
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.amount < 100000
      AND l.status = 'C'
) AS cohort
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = cohort.district_id;

WITH races_2017_not_hosted_in_2000 AS (
  SELECT r.raceId
  FROM races AS r
  WHERE r.year = 2017
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM races AS r2000
      WHERE r2000.year = 2000
        AND r2000.circuitId = r.circuitId
    )
),
stops_per_race AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, COUNT(p.stop) AS pit_stops
  FROM races_2017_not_hosted_in_2000 AS r
  LEFT JOIN pitStops AS p ON p.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.raceId
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(pit_stops), 2) AS average_pit_stops_per_race
FROM stops_per_race;

SELECT
  d.forename,
  d.surname,
  d.url AS wikipedia_page_link,
  d.dob AS date_of_birth,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN q.q3 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS q3_times
FROM drivers AS d
LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q
  ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND d.dob >= '1971-01-01'
  AND d.dob < '1986-01-01'
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.url, d.dob
ORDER BY q3_times DESC, d.dob ASC;

WITH race AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 1995 AND name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
),
timed AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, q.q1
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN race AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  WHERE q.q1 IS NOT NULL AND q.q1 <> ''
),
parsed AS (
  SELECT
    driverId,
    q1,
    CAST(substr(q1, 1, instr(q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
      + CAST(substr(q1, instr(q1, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
      + CAST(substr(q1, instr(q1, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS q1_ms
  FROM timed
)
SELECT
  d.driverRef AS reference_name,
  d.nationality,
  d.dob AS birthday,
  p.q1 AS q1_time
FROM parsed AS p
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = p.driverId
WHERE p.q1_ms = (SELECT MAX(q1_ms) FROM parsed)
ORDER BY d.driverRef;

WITH q1_times AS (
  SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    q.q1,
    CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
      + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
      + CAST(round(CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 4) AS REAL) * 1000) AS INTEGER) AS q1_ms
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE r.year = 1995
    AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
    AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT forename, surname, q1 AS q1_time
FROM q1_times
WHERE q1_ms = (SELECT MIN(q1_ms) FROM q1_times);

WITH di_grassi AS (
  SELECT q.raceId, q.position
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  WHERE r.year = 2010
    AND d.forename = 'Lucas'
    AND d.surname = 'di Grassi'
    AND q.position IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM qualifying AS other
JOIN di_grassi AS lg ON lg.raceId = other.raceId
WHERE other.position IS NOT NULL
  AND other.position > lg.position;

WITH q2_times AS (
  SELECT
    d.nationality,
    CAST(substr(q.q2, 1, instr(q.q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
      + CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
      + CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS ms
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE r.year = 2017
    AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
    AND q.q2 LIKE '_:%'
)
SELECT DISTINCT nationality
FROM q2_times
WHERE ms = (SELECT MIN(ms) FROM q2_times);

WITH runners_up AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.driverId, d.forename
  FROM races AS ra
  JOIN results AS re ON re.raceId = ra.raceId
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = re.driverId
  WHERE ra.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
    AND re.positionOrder = 2
)
SELECT forename, COUNT(*) AS runner_up_count
FROM runners_up
GROUP BY forename
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY runner_up_count DESC, forename ASC;

SELECT
  d.forename,
  d.surname,
  strftime(
    '%H:%M:%S',
    datetime(r.date || ' ' || r.time, '+' || (res.milliseconds / 1000) || ' seconds', '+4 hours')
  ) || '.' || printf('%03d', res.milliseconds % 1000) AS finish_local_time,
  d.url
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix'
  AND res.position = 1;

SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> ''
  AND (q.q3 IS NULL OR q.q3 = '')
ORDER BY d.driverRef;

WITH q2_times AS (
  SELECT
    d.nationality,
    (CAST(substr(q.q2, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60000)
      + (CAST(substr(q.q2, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000)
      + (CAST(substr(q.q2, 7) AS REAL) * 1000) AS q2_ms
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE r.year = 2017
    AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
    AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
),
target AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT q2_ms
  FROM q2_times
  ORDER BY q2_ms
  LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT nationality
FROM q2_times
WHERE q2_ms = (SELECT q2_ms FROM target)
ORDER BY nationality;

WITH longest AS (
  SELECT MAX(milliseconds) AS max_ms
  FROM pitStops
)
SELECT
  c.name AS racetrack_name,
  c.location,
  c.country,
  r.year AS season_year,
  p.duration AS pit_stop_length
FROM pitStops AS p
JOIN longest AS l ON p.milliseconds = l.max_ms
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = p.raceId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
ORDER BY r.year, c.name, p.driverId, p.stop;

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM drivers
    WHERE dob >= '1981-01-01'
      AND dob < '1992-01-01'
),
per_driver AS (
    SELECT c.driverId, COUNT(q.q3) AS q3_lap_times
    FROM cohort c
    LEFT JOIN qualifying q
        ON q.driverId = c.driverId
       AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.driverId
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(q3_lap_times), 2) AS average_q3_lap_times_per_driver
FROM per_driver;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS qualifying1_count
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE d.code IS NULL
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60.0
    + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
  ) > 120
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM drivers AS other
    WHERE other.forename = d.forename
      AND other.driverId <> d.driverId
  );

SELECT d.driverRef AS reference_name,
       SUM(r.points) AS total_points
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r
  ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Robert'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM lapTimes AS lt
    WHERE lt.driverId = r.driverId
      AND lt.raceId = r.raceId
  )
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.driverRef
ORDER BY d.driverRef;

WITH french_races AS (
  SELECT raceId, date
  FROM races
  WHERE year >= 1990
    AND name = 'French Grand Prix'
),
driver_fastest_laps AS (
  SELECT fr.raceId, lt.driverId, MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS fastest_ms
  FROM french_races AS fr
  JOIN lapTimes AS lt ON lt.raceId = fr.raceId
  WHERE lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY fr.raceId, lt.driverId
),
over_90_seconds AS (
  SELECT raceId, driverId, fastest_ms
  FROM driver_fastest_laps
  WHERE fastest_ms > 90000
)
SELECT
  fr.date,
  d.forename,
  d.surname,
  CASE
    WHEN o.fastest_ms IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE printf(
      '%d:%02d.%03d',
      o.fastest_ms / 60000,
      (o.fastest_ms / 1000) % 60,
      o.fastest_ms % 1000
    )
  END AS fastest_lap
FROM french_races AS fr
LEFT JOIN over_90_seconds AS o ON o.raceId = fr.raceId
LEFT JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = o.driverId
ORDER BY fr.date, d.surname, d.forename;

WITH italian_q3 AS (
  SELECT d.forename, d.surname, q.q3
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE d.nationality = 'Italian'
    AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
),
fastest AS (
  SELECT MIN(q3) AS q3
  FROM italian_q3
)
SELECT forename, surname, q3
FROM italian_q3
WHERE q3 = (SELECT q3 FROM fastest)
ORDER BY surname, forename;

WITH british_q3 AS (
  SELECT
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
    r.name AS race_name,
    r.year AS race_year,
    q.q3 AS q3_time,
    CASE
      WHEN q.q3 GLOB '*:*.*' THEN
        CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000 +
        CAST(
          substr(
            q.q3,
            instr(q.q3, ':') + 1,
            instr(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1), '.') - 1
          ) AS INTEGER
        ) * 1000 +
        CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER)
      WHEN q.q3 GLOB '*.*' THEN
        CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, '.') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 1000 +
        CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER)
    END AS q3_ms
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  WHERE d.nationality = 'British'
    AND CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) > 1980
    AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
),
fastest AS (
  SELECT MIN(q3_ms) AS min_ms
  FROM british_q3
  WHERE q3_ms IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT driver_name, race_name, race_year, q3_time
FROM british_q3
WHERE q3_ms = (SELECT min_ms FROM fastest)
ORDER BY race_year, race_name, driver_name;

WITH driver_race_best AS (
  SELECT raceId, driverId, MIN(milliseconds) AS fastest_ms
  FROM lapTimes
  WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY raceId, driverId
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    raceId,
    driverId,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceId ORDER BY fastest_ms) AS speed_rank
  FROM driver_race_best
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM ranked r
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE r.speed_rank = 2
  AND d.dob >= '1976-01-01';

WITH winning_drivers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.forename, d.driverId
  FROM drivers AS d
  JOIN results AS r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
  WHERE r.positionOrder = 1
    AND d.forename IN ('Peter', 'John')
)
SELECT forename, COUNT(*) AS winning_driver_count
FROM winning_drivers
GROUP BY forename
ORDER BY CASE forename WHEN 'Peter' THEN 1 WHEN 'John' THEN 2 END;

WITH q3_times AS (
  SELECT
    driverId,
    CAST(substr(q3, 1, instr(q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
      + CAST(substr(q3, instr(q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
      + CAST(substr(q3, instr(q3, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS time_ms
  FROM qualifying
  WHERE q3 IS NOT NULL AND q3 <> ''
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM q3_times AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE q.time_ms = (SELECT MIN(time_ms) FROM q3_times);

WITH fastest_lap_constructors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT constructorId
  FROM results
  WHERE rank = 1
    AND fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  c.nationality,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN f.constructorId IS NOT NULL THEN c.constructorId
  END) AS constructor_count
FROM constructors AS c
LEFT JOIN fastest_lap_constructors AS f
  ON f.constructorId = c.constructorId
GROUP BY c.nationality
ORDER BY c.nationality;

WITH qualifying_races AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.raceId, r.year
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN driverStandings AS ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = ds.driverId
  WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013
    AND d.nationality = 'Australian'
    AND ds.position BETWEEN 1 AND 19
)
SELECT
  r.year,
  COUNT(ps.raceId) AS pit_stop_count
FROM qualifying_races AS r
LEFT JOIN pitStops AS ps ON ps.raceId = r.raceId
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY r.year;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) > 2
    OR (
      CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) = 2
      AND CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) > 0
    )
  );

WITH september_stops AS (
  SELECT
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_full_name,
    p.duration AS pit_stop_time,
    r.name AS race_name,
    c.name AS circuit_name,
    c.location AS circuit_location,
    p.milliseconds
  FROM pitStops AS p
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = p.raceId
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = p.driverId
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE r.year = 2016
    AND strftime('%m', r.date) = '09'
    AND p.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT driver_full_name, pit_stop_time, race_name, circuit_name, circuit_location
FROM september_stops
WHERE milliseconds = (SELECT MIN(milliseconds) FROM september_stops)
ORDER BY driver_full_name, race_name;

WITH winners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob, d.nationality
  FROM drivers AS d
  JOIN results AS res ON res.driverId = d.driverId
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
  WHERE res.position = 1
    AND r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017
),
selected_driver AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM winners
  ORDER BY dob ASC, forename COLLATE NOCASE ASC, surname COLLATE NOCASE ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
first_win AS (
  SELECT r.name, r.date
  FROM results AS res
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
  JOIN selected_driver AS sd ON sd.driverId = res.driverId
  WHERE res.position = 1
    AND r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017
  ORDER BY r.date ASC, r.name COLLATE NOCASE ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
starts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceId) AS races_started
  FROM results AS res
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
  JOIN selected_driver AS sd ON sd.driverId = res.driverId
  WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017
)
SELECT sd.forename || ' ' || sd.surname AS full_name,
       sd.nationality,
       fw.name AS first_race_won,
       fw.date AS first_win_date,
       s.races_started
FROM selected_driver AS sd
CROSS JOIN first_win AS fw
CROSS JOIN starts AS s;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS runnings
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN status s ON s.statusId = res.statusId
WHERE r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND s.status = 'Accident';

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    c.name AS constructor_name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY
        CAST(substr(q.q2, 1, instr(q.q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER),
        CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, ':') + 1) AS REAL),
        r.grid ASC
    ) AS q2_rank
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = q.raceId
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = q.constructorId
  JOIN results AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId AND r.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE ra.year = 2017
    AND ra.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
    AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
    AND q.q2 <> '\N'
)
SELECT forename, surname, constructor_name
FROM ranked
WHERE q2_rank = 2;

WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT
    q.driverId,
    r.name AS race_name,
    CAST(substr(q.q2, 1, instr(q.q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
      + CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, ':') + 1, instr(q.q2, '.') - instr(q.q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 1000
      + CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS q2_ms
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE r.year = 2017
    AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
    AND q.q2 <> '\N'
)
SELECT d.surname, p.race_name
FROM parsed p
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = p.driverId
WHERE p.q2_ms = (SELECT MIN(q2_ms) FROM parsed)
ORDER BY d.surname, p.race_name;

SELECT d.number AS permanent_number
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.position = 1
  AND q.q3 = (
    SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
    FROM qualifying q2
    JOIN races r2 ON r2.raceId = q2.raceId
    WHERE r2.year = 2017
      AND r2.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
      AND q2.position = 1
      AND q2.q3 IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT d.code AS driver_code, q.q3 AS fastest_q3_time
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 = (
    SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
    FROM qualifying q2
    JOIN races r2 ON r2.raceId = q2.raceId
    WHERE r2.year = 2017
      AND r2.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
      AND q2.q3 IS NOT NULL
  );

WITH italian_gp AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2017
    AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
),
q3_times AS (
  SELECT d.nationality, q.q3
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN italian_gp AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT nationality
FROM q3_times
WHERE q3 = (SELECT MIN(q3) FROM q3_times);

WITH chinese_gp AS (
  SELECT raceId, year, time
  FROM races
  WHERE name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
    AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
),
earliest AS (
  SELECT MIN(time) AS start_time
  FROM chinese_gp
),
selected_race AS (
  SELECT c.*
  FROM chinese_gp AS c
  JOIN earliest AS e ON c.time = e.start_time
  ORDER BY c.year DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  s.year AS season_year,
  s.time AS scheduled_local_start_time,
  runner_up.time AS runner_up_time_gap_to_winner
FROM selected_race AS s
JOIN results AS winner
  ON winner.raceId = s.raceId AND winner.position = 1
JOIN results AS runner_up
  ON runner_up.raceId = s.raceId AND runner_up.position = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT d.code
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
ORDER BY d.code;

SELECT r.year, d.forename, d.surname, res.time AS finish_time
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017
  AND r.time IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(substr(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 17
  AND res.positionOrder = 1
ORDER BY r.year;

SELECT d.number AS permanent_career_race_number, d.surname
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
    + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
  ) < 98.000
ORDER BY d.surname;

WITH timed_races AS (
  SELECT
    c.circuitRef,
    CAST(substr(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600
      + CAST(substr(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60
      + CAST(substr(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS start_seconds
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
),
extrema AS (
  SELECT MIN(start_seconds) AS earliest_seconds,
         MAX(start_seconds) AS latest_seconds
  FROM timed_races
)
SELECT
  (
    SELECT group_concat(circuitRef, ', ')
    FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT circuitRef
      FROM timed_races, extrema
      WHERE start_seconds = earliest_seconds
      ORDER BY circuitRef
    )
  ) AS earliest_circuit_refs,
  earliest_seconds AS earliest_start_seconds,
  (
    SELECT group_concat(circuitRef, ', ')
    FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT circuitRef
      FROM timed_races, extrema
      WHERE start_seconds = latest_seconds
      ORDER BY circuitRef
    )
  ) AS latest_circuit_refs,
  latest_seconds AS latest_start_seconds,
  latest_seconds - earliest_seconds AS gap_seconds
FROM extrema;

WITH career_highs AS (
  SELECT
    d.driverId,
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    d.dob,
    MAX(CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) AS career_high_speed
  FROM drivers AS d
  JOIN results AS r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
  WHERE d.dob >= '1980-01-01'
    AND d.dob < '1991-01-01'
    AND r.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob
)
SELECT forename, surname
FROM career_highs
ORDER BY career_high_speed DESC, dob ASC, surname ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.driverRef
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 IS NULL
ORDER BY q.q1 DESC, q.driverId ASC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS withdrawn_drivers
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN status s ON s.statusId = r.statusId
WHERE ra.year = 1962
  AND ra.name = 'British Grand Prix'
  AND s.status = 'Withdrew';

SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Finished' OR s.status LIKE '+% Lap%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
  2
) AS percentage_classified_finishers
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN status s ON s.statusId = r.statusId
WHERE ra.year = 1957
  AND ra.name = 'British Grand Prix';

WITH event_counts AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.event_name,
    e.event_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS attendees
  FROM event AS e
  LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
    ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
  GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name, e.event_date
),
fall_average AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendees), 1) AS avg_attendees
  FROM event_counts
  WHERE event_date >= '2019-09-01'
    AND event_date < '2019-12-01'
),
soccer AS (
  SELECT attendees AS soccer_attendees
  FROM event_counts
  WHERE event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
)
SELECT
  soccer.soccer_attendees,
  fall_average.avg_attendees,
  CASE
    WHEN soccer.soccer_attendees > fall_average.avg_attendees THEN 'more'
    WHEN soccer.soccer_attendees < fall_average.avg_attendees THEN 'fewer'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS verdict
FROM soccer
CROSS JOIN fall_average;

WITH college_departments AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT department
    FROM major
    WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
),
department_major_stats AS (
    SELECT
        d.department,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.major_id) AS offered_major_count,
        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.major_name) AS majors_offered,
        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN member_major.major_id IS NOT NULL THEN m.major_name
        END) AS majors_held
    FROM college_departments AS d
    JOIN major AS m
        ON m.department = d.department
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT link_to_major AS major_id
        FROM member
    ) AS member_major
        ON member_major.major_id = m.major_id
    GROUP BY d.department
),
member_counts AS (
    SELECT m.department, COUNT(*) AS member_major_rows
    FROM member AS mem
    JOIN major AS m
        ON m.major_id = mem.link_to_major
    GROUP BY m.department
)
SELECT
    stats.department,
    stats.majors_offered,
    stats.majors_held,
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(counts.member_major_rows, 0) * 1.0
        / stats.offered_major_count,
        2
    ) AS average_members_per_major_offered
FROM department_major_stats AS stats
LEFT JOIN member_counts AS counts
    ON counts.department = stats.department
ORDER BY stats.department;

WITH ece_college AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT college
  FROM major
  WHERE department LIKE '%Electrical%Computer%Engineering%'
),
college_departments AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT department
  FROM major
  WHERE college IN (SELECT college FROM ece_college)
),
participating_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member
  FROM attendance
),
department_dues AS (
  SELECT mj.department, SUM(i.amount) AS total_dues
  FROM member m
  JOIN major mj ON mj.major_id = m.link_to_major
  JOIN income i ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
  JOIN participating_members pm ON pm.link_to_member = m.member_id
  WHERE m.position = 'Member'
    AND i.source = 'Dues'
    AND mj.college IN (SELECT college FROM ece_college)
  GROUP BY mj.department
)
SELECT cd.department, COALESCE(dd.total_dues, 0) AS total_dues
FROM college_departments cd
LEFT JOIN department_dues dd ON dd.department = cd.department
ORDER BY cd.department;

WITH member_budget_lines AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        link_to_member AS member_id,
        link_to_budget AS budget_id
    FROM expense
    WHERE cost > 50
),
member_totals AS (
    SELECT
        mbl.member_id,
        SUM(b.remaining) AS total_remaining
    FROM member_budget_lines AS mbl
    JOIN budget AS b
        ON b.budget_id = mbl.budget_id
    GROUP BY mbl.member_id
)
SELECT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    ROUND(mt.total_remaining, 2) AS total_remaining_dollars
FROM member_totals AS mt
JOIN member AS m
    ON m.member_id = mt.member_id
ORDER BY
    mt.total_remaining DESC,
    m.last_name ASC,
    m.first_name ASC;

SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS total_dues_dollars
FROM income AS i
WHERE i.source = 'Dues'
  AND i.link_to_member IN (
    SELECT a.link_to_member
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    WHERE e.event_name LIKE '%Football%'
  );

WITH tyler_college AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ma.college
  FROM member AS m
  JOIN major AS ma ON ma.major_id = m.link_to_major
  WHERE m.first_name = 'Tyler'
    AND m.last_name = 'Hewitt'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ma.major_name) AS majors_with_no_enrolled_members
FROM major AS ma
JOIN tyler_college AS tc ON tc.college = ma.college
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM member AS m
  WHERE m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
);

SELECT e.event_name, e.location, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS members_attended
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.type = 'Budget'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name, e.location
ORDER BY e.event_date, e.event_name;

WITH attendee_counts AS (
    SELECT
        m.link_to_major AS major_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS attendee_count
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN event AS e
        ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    JOIN member AS m
        ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
    WHERE e.event_name = 'Football game'
    GROUP BY m.link_to_major
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        major_id,
        attendee_count,
        MAX(attendee_count) OVER () AS max_count
    FROM attendee_counts
)
SELECT
    ma.major_name,
    r.attendee_count
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN major AS ma
    ON ma.major_id = r.major_id
WHERE r.attendee_count = r.max_count
ORDER BY ma.major_name;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member m WHERE m.link_to_major = major.major_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS percentage_unrepresented_majors FROM major;

WITH over_budget_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event AS event_id
  FROM budget
  WHERE amount - spent < 0
),
semester_bounds AS (
  SELECT MIN(event_date) AS start_date, MAX(event_date) AS end_date
  FROM event
),
expense_kinds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(j.value) AS kind
  FROM expense x
  JOIN budget b ON b.budget_id = x.link_to_budget
  JOIN over_budget_events o ON o.event_id = b.link_to_event
  JOIN event ev ON ev.event_id = o.event_id
  CROSS JOIN semester_bounds sb
  JOIN json_each(
    '["' || REPLACE(REPLACE(x.expense_description, '"', '\\"'), ', ', '","') || '"]'
  ) j
  WHERE ev.event_date BETWEEN sb.start_date AND sb.end_date
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT kind) AS kind_count
FROM expense_kinds;

WITH attended AS (
  SELECT
    link_to_event AS event_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS attendee_count
  FROM attendance
  GROUP BY link_to_event
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) > 0
),
water_cost AS (
  SELECT
    b.link_to_event AS event_id,
    SUM(x.cost) AS total_cost
  FROM expense AS x
  JOIN budget AS b ON b.budget_id = x.link_to_budget
  WHERE LOWER(x.expense_description) LIKE '%water%'
  GROUP BY b.link_to_event
)
SELECT
  e.event_name,
  ROUND(COALESCE(w.total_cost, 0) / a.attendee_count, 2) AS water_cost_per_attendee
FROM attended AS a
JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.event_id
LEFT JOIN water_cost AS w ON w.event_id = e.event_id
ORDER BY e.event_name, e.event_id;

WITH roster_classification AS (
  SELECT
    m.member_id,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM major AS maj
        WHERE maj.major_id = m.link_to_major
          AND maj.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
      ) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS in_humanities_social_sciences
  FROM member AS m
)
SELECT
  SUM(in_humanities_social_sciences) AS members_majoring_in_college,
  SUM(1 - in_humanities_social_sciences) AS members_not_majoring_in_college,
  COUNT(*) AS total_members
FROM roster_classification;

WITH vp AS (
  SELECT member_id
  FROM member
  WHERE position = 'Vice President'
),
latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(e.expense_date) AS expense_date
  FROM expense AS e
  JOIN vp ON e.link_to_member = vp.member_id
)
SELECT latest.expense_date,
       SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost
FROM latest
JOIN expense AS e ON e.expense_date = latest.expense_date
WHERE latest.expense_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY latest.expense_date;

SELECT
  e.type AS event_category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS club_members_attended
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
  ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.location = 'MU 215'
GROUP BY e.type
ORDER BY e.type;

WITH college_counts AS (
  SELECT ma.college, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.major_id) AS major_count
  FROM member AS me
  JOIN major AS ma ON me.link_to_major = ma.major_id
  GROUP BY ma.college
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT college, major_count, MAX(major_count) OVER () AS top_count
  FROM college_counts
)
SELECT college, major_count
FROM ranked
WHERE major_count = top_count
ORDER BY college;

WITH event_totals AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.event_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(b.amount), 0) AS total_budget,
    COALESCE(SUM(b.spent), 0) AS total_spending
  FROM event AS e
  LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
  WHERE LOWER(e.status) = 'closed'
  GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
),
eligible_events AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM event_totals
  WHERE total_spending <= total_budget
),
purchase_counts AS (
  SELECT b.link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS purchases
  FROM budget AS b
  JOIN expense AS x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
  GROUP BY b.link_to_event
)
SELECT e.event_name
FROM eligible_events AS e
LEFT JOIN purchase_counts AS p ON p.event_id = e.event_id
ORDER BY COALESCE(p.purchases, 0) DESC, e.event_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT e.type AS event_type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
  FROM event e
  JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
  WHERE date(e.event_date) >= date('2019-09-01')
    AND date(e.event_date) < date('2020-06-01')
  GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT event_type, member_count
FROM type_counts
WHERE member_count = (SELECT MAX(member_count) FROM type_counts)
ORDER BY event_type;

SELECT e.expense_description AS item_name, COUNT(*) AS purchase_record_count
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE LOWER(b.category) = 'food'
GROUP BY e.expense_description
ORDER BY purchase_record_count DESC, item_name COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  e.expense_description AS item_name,
  b.category AS budget_category,
  SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost_usd
FROM expense AS e
JOIN budget AS b
  ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event AS v
  ON b.link_to_event = v.event_id
WHERE v.event_name = 'October Meeting'
  AND LOWER(TRIM(e.approved)) IN ('approved', 'yes', 'true', '1')
GROUP BY e.expense_description, b.category
ORDER BY b.category, e.expense_description;

SELECT e.expense_description AS item_name, COUNT(*) AS times_bought
FROM expense AS e
JOIN member AS m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha'
  AND m.last_name = 'Harrison'
GROUP BY e.expense_description
ORDER BY e.expense_description;

WITH month_expenses AS (
  SELECT
    link_to_member AS member_id,
    expense_description,
    cost
  FROM expense
  WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01'
    AND expense_date < '2019-12-01'
),
member_stats AS (
  SELECT
    member_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT expense_description) AS different_kinds,
    SUM(cost) AS total_spending
  FROM month_expenses
  GROUP BY member_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    MAX(different_kinds) OVER () AS max_kinds
  FROM member_stats
)
SELECT
  m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
  r.different_kinds,
  r.total_spending
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = r.member_id
WHERE r.different_kinds = r.max_kinds
ORDER BY full_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT maj.major_name) AS different_major_count
FROM member AS mem
JOIN major AS maj ON mem.link_to_major = maj.major_id
WHERE maj.department = 'Political Science Department';

SELECT AVG(CAST(m.height_cm AS REAL)) AS average_height_cm

JOIN publisher AS mp ON mp.id = m.publisher_id

  AND m.height_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (

    FROM hero_power AS mhp
    WHERE mhp.hero_id = m.id
