        FROM superhero AS d
        JOIN publisher AS dp ON dp.id = d.publisher_id
        JOIN hero_power AS dhp ON dhp.hero_id = d.id
        WHERE dp.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
          AND dhp.power_id = mhp.power_id
      )
  );

WITH strength_heroes AS (
  SELECT ha.hero_id
  FROM hero_attribute AS ha
  JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
  WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Super Strength'
    AND ha.attribute_value = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
FROM hero_power AS hp
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM strength_heroes AS sh
  WHERE sh.hero_id = hp.hero_id
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM hero_power AS other_hp
  WHERE other_hp.power_id = hp.power_id
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM strength_heroes AS sh
      WHERE sh.hero_id = other_hp.hero_id
    )
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL)), 1) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE LOWER(c.colour) = 'green'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE LOWER(a.alignment) NOT IN ('good', 'bad');

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(h.weight_kg AS REAL)), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS h
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = h.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
    SELECT ha_ab.attribute_value
    FROM superhero AS ab
    JOIN hero_attribute AS ha_ab ON ha_ab.hero_id = ab.id
    JOIN attribute AS a_ab ON a_ab.id = ha_ab.attribute_id
    WHERE ab.superhero_name = 'Abomination'
      AND a_ab.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  );

WITH power_counts AS (
  SELECT
    h.id,
    g.gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS listed_power_count
  FROM superhero AS h
  JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = h.gender_id
  JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = h.hair_colour_id
  LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = h.id
  WHERE LOWER(c.colour) = 'blue'
    AND LOWER(g.gender) IN ('male', 'female')
  GROUP BY h.id, g.gender
)
SELECT
  g.gender,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN p.listed_power_count >= 10 THEN 1 END) AS superhero_count
FROM gender AS g
LEFT JOIN power_counts AS p ON p.gender = g.gender
WHERE LOWER(g.gender) IN ('male', 'female')
GROUP BY g.gender
ORDER BY g.gender;

WITH strength_attribute AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM attribute
    WHERE attribute_name = 'Strength'
),
hulk_strength AS (
    SELECT ha.attribute_value
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
    JOIN strength_attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
    WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
)
SELECT CAST(ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS INTEGER) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN strength_attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND ha.attribute_value IN (SELECT attribute_value FROM hulk_strength);

WITH ranked_heights AS (
  SELECT id,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS height_rank
  FROM superhero
  WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL
),
tallest AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM ranked_heights
  WHERE height_rank <= 10
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS different_superpowers
FROM tallest
LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = tallest.id;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero AS s
WHERE s.publisher_id = (
  SELECT publisher_id
  FROM superhero
  WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb'
)
AND s.race_id IS NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2) AS average_superpowers_per_hero
FROM (
  SELECT s.id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
  FROM superhero AS s
  JOIN race AS r ON r.id = s.race_id
  JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
  LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
  WHERE r.race IN ('God', 'Eternal')
    AND g.gender = 'Male'
  GROUP BY s.id
);

WITH cryokinesis_holders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
  WHERE LOWER(sp.power_name) = 'cryokinesis'
),
related_heroes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT power_id
    FROM hero_power
    WHERE hero_id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM cryokinesis_holders)
  ) shared_powers ON shared_powers.power_id = hp.power_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 1)
FROM (
  SELECT rh.hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
  FROM related_heroes rh
  JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = rh.hero_id
  GROUP BY rh.hero_id
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.height_cm AS REAL)), 1) AS average_height_cm
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN superhero AS a ON a.superhero_name = 'A-Bomb'
WHERE s.race_id = a.race_id
  AND s.height_cm IS NOT NULL;

SELECT AVG(CAST(h.weight_kg AS REAL)) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS h
WHERE h.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND h.race_id IN (
    SELECT r.id
    FROM race AS r
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM superhero AS female_hero
      JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = female_hero.gender_id
      WHERE female_hero.race_id = r.id
        AND LOWER(g.gender) = 'female'
    )
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS publisher_count
FROM publisher p
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM superhero s
  WHERE s.publisher_id = p.id
    AND s.height_cm > 200
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS superhero_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Good'
  AND (
    s.publisher_id IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM publisher AS p
      WHERE p.id = s.publisher_id
        AND p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
    )
  );

WITH blackwulf_publisher AS (
  SELECT publisher_id
  FROM superhero
  WHERE superhero_name = 'Blackwulf'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT h.id) AS hero_count
FROM superhero AS h
JOIN blackwulf_publisher AS b
  ON h.publisher_id = b.publisher_id
WHERE h.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM superhero AS other
    WHERE other.eye_colour_id = h.eye_colour_id
      AND other.publisher_id IS NOT NULL
      AND other.publisher_id <> b.publisher_id
  );

WITH target_publisher AS (
  SELECT publisher_id
  FROM superhero
  WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
),
race_counts AS (
  SELECT r.race, COUNT(*) AS superhero_count
  FROM superhero AS s
  JOIN target_publisher AS tp
    ON s.publisher_id = tp.publisher_id
  JOIN race AS r
    ON s.race_id = r.id
  WHERE s.race_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY r.race
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT race, superhero_count,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY superhero_count DESC) AS race_rank
  FROM race_counts
)
SELECT race, superhero_count
FROM ranked
WHERE race_rank = 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL)), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(ha.attribute_value AS REAL)), 1) AS average_intelligence_score
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  JOIN superpower p ON p.id = hp.power_id
  WHERE LOWER(p.power_name) IN ('super speed', 'death touch')
) AS matching_heroes
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = matching_heroes.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE LOWER(a.attribute_name) = 'intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value IS NOT NULL;

WITH per_hero AS (
    SELECT
        g.gender,
        s.id,
        COUNT(hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM superhero AS s
    JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
    LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    WHERE s.full_name IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
      AND instr(TRIM(s.full_name), ' ') > 0
      AND g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
    GROUP BY g.gender, s.id
)
SELECT
    gender,
    ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2) AS average_superpowers_per_hero
FROM per_hero
GROUP BY gender
ORDER BY CASE gender WHEN 'Male' THEN 1 WHEN 'Female' THEN 2 END;

SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.height_cm IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(s.height_cm AS REAL) END), 2) AS average_height_cm,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL) END), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
  AND c.colour = 'Green';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(h.weight_kg AS REAL))) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS h
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = h.alignment_id
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = h.skin_colour_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = h.id
JOIN superpower AS p ON p.id = hp.power_id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
  AND c.colour = 'Green'
  AND p.power_name = 'Flight'
  AND h.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(sh.weight_kg AS REAL)), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS sh
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = sh.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'
  AND sh.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_power AS hp
    WHERE hp.hero_id = sh.id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL)), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE LOWER(g.gender) = 'female'
  AND LOWER(a.alignment) = 'good'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

WITH lightest AS (
  SELECT MIN(weight_kg) AS min_weight
  FROM superhero
  WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL
),
counts AS (
  SELECT s.id, COUNT(hp.power_id) AS power_count
  FROM superhero AS s
  LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
  WHERE s.weight_kg = (SELECT min_weight FROM lightest)
  GROUP BY s.id
)
SELECT MAX(power_count)
FROM counts;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS hero_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE LOWER(a.alignment) = 'neutral'
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '';

WITH brown_hair_eye_colours AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT eye.colour
  FROM superhero AS hero
  JOIN colour AS hair ON hair.id = hero.hair_colour_id
  JOIN colour AS eye ON eye.id = hero.eye_colour_id
  WHERE hair.colour = 'Brown'
)
SELECT eye.colour AS eye_colour, COUNT(*) AS hero_count
FROM superhero AS hero
JOIN colour AS eye ON eye.id = hero.eye_colour_id
JOIN colour AS hair ON hair.id = hero.hair_colour_id
WHERE eye.colour IN (SELECT colour FROM brown_hair_eye_colours)
  AND (hair.colour <> 'Brown' OR hair.colour IS NULL)
GROUP BY eye.colour
ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC;

SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
  2
) AS percentage_good
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '';

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN s.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT s.id), 2) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
JOIN alignment a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hero_power hp WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id);

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM superhero AS s
   JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
   WHERE s.weight_kg IS NULL AND c.colour = 'No Colour')
  -
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM superhero AS s
   JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
   WHERE s.weight_kg IS NULL AND LOWER(c.colour) = 'blue')
  AS difference;

WITH elevated AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.UA IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA > 8.0)
      OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA > 6.5)
    )
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_patients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_patients
  FROM elevated
)
SELECT
  male_patients,
  female_patients,
  CAST(male_patients AS REAL) / NULLIF(female_patients, 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM counts;

WITH pt_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE Date = '2026-10-09'
    AND PT >= 14
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN pt_patients AS x ON x.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.Birthday < date('2026-10-09', '-56 years')
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(SEX) = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
  2
) AS female_percentage
FROM eligible

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Description IS NULL
  AND l.CRP LIKE '%+%';

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT p.ID
  FROM Patient AS p
  WHERE lower(p.SEX) IN ('f', 'female', '2')
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND lower(trim(l.SC170)) IN ('negative', '0')
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS distinct_female_patients
FROM eligible;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN LOWER(p.Admission) = 'inpatient' THEN p.ID
    END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID), 0),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.Birthday >= '1930-01-01'
  AND p.Birthday < '1941-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID = p.ID)
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND e.Thrombosis = 1
  );

WITH rnp_tests AS (
  SELECT
    ID,
    Date,
    CAST(RNP AS REAL) AS rnp_value,
    "T-BIL" AS total_bilirubin
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL
),
strongest_rnp AS (
  SELECT MAX(rnp_value) AS max_rnp_value
  FROM rnp_tests
),
strongest_tests AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rnp_tests
  WHERE rnp_value = (SELECT max_rnp_value FROM strongest_rnp)
),
highest_bilirubin AS (
  SELECT MAX(total_bilirubin) AS max_total_bilirubin
  FROM strongest_tests
)
SELECT
  s.total_bilirubin AS total_bilirubin_level,
  s.Date AS lab_test_date,
  p.ID AS patient_id,
  p.SEX AS sex,
  p.Birthday AS birthday
FROM strongest_tests AS s
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = s.ID
WHERE s.total_bilirubin = (
  SELECT max_total_bilirubin FROM highest_bilirubin
);

WITH thrombosis_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
    WHERE e.Thrombosis = 1
      AND p.Birthday > '1960-01-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM thrombosis_patients AS tp
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = tp.ID
      AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(l.RNP) <> ''
      AND LOWER(TRIM(l.RNP)) <> 'negative'
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 10
);

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.Admission = '-'
      AND l.SSA IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(l.SSA) NOT IN ('', 'negative', '0')
),
rnp_values AS (
    SELECT l.ID, CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) AS anti_rnp_titer
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN eligible AS e ON e.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(l.RNP) <> ''
),
maxima AS (
    SELECT ID, MAX(anti_rnp_titer) AS anti_rnp_titer
    FROM rnp_values
    GROUP BY ID
),
top_value AS (
    SELECT MAX(anti_rnp_titer) AS anti_rnp_titer
    FROM maxima
)
SELECT m.ID AS patient_id, m.anti_rnp_titer
FROM maxima AS m
JOIN top_value AS t ON m.anti_rnp_titer = t.anti_rnp_titer
ORDER BY m.ID;

WITH mctd_only AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis = 'MCTD'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM mctd_only p
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l.ID = p.ID
    AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
)
AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l.ID = p.ID
    AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 5
);

WITH never_examined AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Patient AS p
  WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
    )
),
lab_dates AS (
  SELECT n.ID, n.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT l.Date) AS date_count
  FROM never_examined AS n
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = n.ID
  GROUP BY n.ID, n.SEX
)
SELECT SEX, ROUND(AVG(date_count), 2) AS average_laboratory_test_dates
FROM lab_dates
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY SEX;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT
    l.ID AS patient_id,
    l.Date AS test_date,
    l."DNA" AS anti_dna_level
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE p.SEX = 'Female'
    AND p.Admission = 'Inpatient'
    AND l."DNA" IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    patient_id,
    test_date,
    anti_dna_level,
    MAX(anti_dna_level) OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id) AS highest_level
  FROM eligible
)
SELECT patient_id, test_date, anti_dna_level
FROM ranked
WHERE anti_dna_level = highest_level
ORDER BY patient_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  WHERE l.ID = p.ID
    AND l.HCT IS NOT NULL
    AND (l.HCT <= 29 OR l.HCT >= 52)
)
AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  WHERE l.ID = p.ID
    AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 16
)
AND (
  p.Diagnosis LIKE '%thrombosis%'
  OR p.Description IS NOT NULL
);

SELECT MAX(CAST(L.RNP AS REAL)) AS highest_anti_ribonuclear_protein_value
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Admission LIKE '%thrombosis%'
  AND L.RNP IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(L.RNP) <> ''
  AND LOWER(P.Description) LIKE '%outpatient clinic%';

WITH exact_overlap_patients AS (
  SELECT p."ID"
  FROM Patient AS p
  WHERE TRIM(p."Diagnosis") IN ('RA, SJS', 'SJS, RA')
),
platelet_status AS (
  SELECT
    e."ID",
    MAX(CASE WHEN l."PLT" > 100 AND l."PLT" < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_normal_platelet
  FROM exact_overlap_patients AS e
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l."ID" = e."ID"
  GROUP BY e."ID"
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN has_normal_platelet = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS patients_with_normal_platelet_result,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN has_normal_platelet = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS patients_never_with_normal_platelet_result
FROM platelet_status;

WITH sle_female_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
    AND lower(e.Diagnosis) LIKE '%systemic lupus erythematosus%'
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.TP - 8.5), 3) AS average_deviation
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN sle_female_ids AS s ON s.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TP > 8.5;

SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5
  AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

WITH qualifying_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE `U-PRO` IN ('3', '4', '300', '1000', '>=1000', '≥1000')
),
birth_years AS (
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS birth_year
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN qualifying_patients AS q ON q.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(1999 - birth_year) AS average_age_years
FROM birth_years
WHERE birth_year IS NOT NULL;

WITH qualifying_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 32
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS women,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS men
FROM qualifying_patients AS q
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = q.ID;

WITH psoriatic_patients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%'
),
per_patient AS (
  SELECT p.ID, COUNT(l.ID) AS lab_count
  FROM psoriatic_patients AS p
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY p.ID
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(lab_count), 0) AS total_laboratory_tests,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lab_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
    AS patients_with_no_laboratory_tests
FROM per_patient;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE date(e."Examination Date") >= date('1997-01-01')
  AND date(e."Examination Date") < date('1998-01-01')
  AND e.Thrombosis = 1;

SELECT e."Symptoms" AS symptom, COUNT(*) AS episode_count
FROM "Examination" e
JOIN "Patient" p ON e."ID" = p."ID"
WHERE e."Thrombosis" = 1
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(p."Diagnosis", '')) LIKE '%sle%'
GROUP BY e."Symptoms"
ORDER BY episode_count DESC, symptom COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(COALESCE("Diagnosis", '')) LIKE '%sle%'
        OR LOWER(COALESCE("Diagnosis", '')) LIKE '%systemic lupus erythematosus%'
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END
  ) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
  2
) AS percentage_thrombosis_patients_with_sle_at_examination
FROM Examination
WHERE "Thrombosis" = 1;

SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.Date >= '1994-01-01'
  AND l.Date < '1995-01-01'
  AND l.GOT < 60
  AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT l.ID
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  WHERE l.LDH > 600
    AND l.LDH < 800
    AND (
      CAST(l."U-PRO" AS REAL) >= 300
      OR LOWER(l."U-PRO") LIKE '%at least%'
    )
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  p.ID AS patient_id,
  CAST(
    (julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.2425
    AS INTEGER
  ) AS completed_age_years
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE e.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND l.UN < 30 AND p.SEX = 'F'
) - (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE e.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND l.UN < 30 AND p.SEX = 'M'
) AS difference;

WITH sex_totals AS (
  SELECT SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS total_patients
  FROM Patient
  WHERE SEX IN ('M', 'F')
  GROUP BY SEX
),
out_of_range AS (
  SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patients_with_creatinine_ge_1_5
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.SEX IN ('M', 'F')
    AND l.CRE >= 1.5
  GROUP BY p.SEX
)
SELECT
  s.SEX,
  COALESCE(o.patients_with_creatinine_ge_1_5, 0) AS patients_with_creatinine_ge_1_5,
  s.total_patients,
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(o.patients_with_creatinine_ge_1_5, 0) / s.total_patients, 1) AS percentage
FROM sex_totals s
LEFT JOIN out_of_range o ON o.SEX = s.SEX
ORDER BY CASE s.SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 END;

WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT
    p.Admission AS admission_status,
    l.ID AS patient_id,
    l."T-CHO" AS t_cho,
    MAX(l."T-CHO") OVER (PARTITION BY p.Admission) AS group_max
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
    AND l."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT admission_status, patient_id, t_cho
FROM grouped
WHERE t_cho = group_max
ORDER BY CASE admission_status WHEN '+' THEN 0 WHEN '-' THEN 1 END, patient_id;

WITH patient_levels AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    p.ID AS patient_id,
    CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) AS rnp_level
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE strftime('%Y', p."First Date") = '1991'
    AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(l.RNP) <> ''
),
highest AS (
  SELECT MAX(rnp_level) AS max_level
  FROM patient_levels
)
SELECT patient_id, rnp_level
FROM patient_levels
WHERE rnp_level = (SELECT max_level FROM highest)
ORDER BY patient_id;

WITH latest_lab AS (
  SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS latest_date
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
),
latest_sc170 AS (
  SELECT ID, SC170,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY ID
           ORDER BY Date DESC, rowid DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE SC170 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT p.ID
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN latest_lab AS ll ON ll.ID = p.ID
JOIN latest_sc170 AS ls ON ls.ID = p.ID AND ls.rn = 1
WHERE ll.latest_date > '1997-01-01'
  AND ls.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
ORDER BY p.ID;

WITH patients_with_abnormal_ssa AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE SSA IS NOT NULL
    AND LOWER(TRIM(SSA)) NOT IN ('negative', 'zero')
),
patients_with_positive_proteinuria AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
    AND LOWER(TRIM("U-PRO")) NOT IN ('negative', 'none')
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM patients_with_abnormal_ssa s
JOIN patients_with_positive_proteinuria p ON p.ID = s.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) < 8;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.Admission <> '-'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.ALP >= 300
  );

SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL)) AS highest_anti_RNP_level
FROM Laboratory
WHERE CRE < 1.5
  AND RNP IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(p.SEX)) IN ('f', 'female') THEN 'female'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(p.SEX)) IN ('m', 'male') THEN 'male'
  END AS sex,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(p.SEX)) IN ('f', 'female', 'm', 'male')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.HGB < 7.0
  )
GROUP BY sex;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT ID, Date, RNP
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE GOT >= 60
    AND RNP IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT ID, Date, RNP,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(RNP AS REAL) DESC) AS rnk
  FROM eligible
)
SELECT ID AS patient_id,
       Date AS laboratory_test_date,
       RNP AS anti_ribonuclear_protein_reading
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY ID, Date;

WITH eligible_ids AS (
  SELECT l.ID
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE p.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
    AND (
      l.FG < 150
      OR l.FG > 450
      OR TRIM(UPPER(l."U-PRO")) IN ('3', '3+', '4', '4+')
      OR (
        TRIM(l."U-PRO") GLOB '[0-9]*'
        AND CAST(l."U-PRO" AS REAL) >= 300
      )
      OR (
        UPPER(TRIM(l."U-PRO")) GLOB '>=*'
        AND CAST(SUBSTR(TRIM(l."U-PRO"), 3) AS REAL) >= 300
      )
    )
  GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM eligible_ids;

WITH unknown_sex AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE SEX IS NULL
),
patient_lab AS (
  SELECT
    u.ID,
    COUNT(l.ID) AS lab_result_count,
    MAX(CASE WHEN l."T-BIL" >= 2.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_elevated_bilirubin
  FROM unknown_sex AS u
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = u.ID
  GROUP BY u.ID
)
SELECT
  COUNT(CASE WHEN lab_result_count > 0 THEN 1 END) AS patients_with_any_laboratory_result,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN lab_result_count > 0 AND has_elevated_bilirubin = 1 THEN 1 END) AS patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin
FROM patient_lab;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND p.Birthday >= '1945-01-01'
  AND p.Birthday < '1990-01-01'
  AND p.Admission LIKE '+%'
  AND e.ANA = 1
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient AS p
    WHERE p.Admission = '-'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Laboratory AS h
          WHERE h.ID = p.ID
            AND h.HGB < 10
      )
),
per_patient AS (
    SELECT e.ID,
           e.SEX,
           MAX(
               CASE
                   WHEN lower(trim(l.RNP)) = 'negative' THEN 0
                   ELSE CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)
               END
           ) AS highest_rnp
    FROM eligible AS e
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = e.ID
    WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND trim(l.RNP) <> ''
    GROUP BY e.ID, e.SEX
),
maximum AS (
    SELECT MAX(highest_rnp) AS value
    FROM per_patient
)
SELECT p.ID AS patient_id,
       p.SEX AS sex,
       p.highest_rnp AS highest_ever_anti_ribonuclear_protein_antibody_level
FROM per_patient AS p
JOIN maximum AS m ON p.highest_rnp = m.value
ORDER BY p.ID;

WITH first_lab AS (
  SELECT ID, MIN(Date) AS first_date
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN first_lab AS f
  ON l.ID = f.ID
 AND l.Date = f.first_date
WHERE l.GOT < 60
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 10;

WITH proteinuria_tests AS (
  SELECT
    ID,
    Date,
    "U-PRO" AS proteinuria_level,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY ID
      ORDER BY Date DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  p.ID AS patient_id,
  p.SEX AS sex,
  t.Date AS most_recent_proteinuria_test_date,
  t.proteinuria_level
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN proteinuria_tests AS t
  ON t.ID = p.ID
WHERE t.rn = 1
ORDER BY p.ID;

WITH rnp_positive AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) >= 16
),
normal_gpt AS (
  SELECT ID, MAX(GPT) AS highest_normal_gpt
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE GPT < 60
  GROUP BY ID
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.Birthday,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY ng.highest_normal_gpt DESC, p.ID ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM rnp_positive rp
  JOIN normal_gpt ng ON ng.ID = rp.ID
  JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = rp.ID
)
SELECT Birthday
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY rn;

WITH thrombosis_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Examination
  WHERE Thrombosis = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS female_patient_count
FROM thrombosis_patients AS tp
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = tp.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.PT < 14
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 16
  );

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l."T-BIL" >= 1.2
  )
ORDER BY p.SEX, p.ID;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.Admission
  FROM Patient AS p
  WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
    AND p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
    AND p.Birthday <= date('2026-10-09', '-50 years')
),
rnp_by_patient AS (
  SELECT l.ID,
         MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_elevated_rnp
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY l.ID
),
categorized AS (
  SELECT CASE e.Admission
           WHEN '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital'
           WHEN '-' THEN 'Followed at the outpatient clinic'
         END AS care_setting,
         COALESCE(r.has_elevated_rnp, 0) AS has_elevated_rnp
  FROM eligible AS e
  LEFT JOIN rnp_by_patient AS r ON r.ID = e.ID
)
SELECT care_setting,
       SUM(CASE WHEN has_elevated_rnp = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_at_least_one_rnp_ge_4,
       SUM(CASE WHEN has_elevated_rnp = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_no_rnp_ge_4
FROM categorized
GROUP BY care_setting
ORDER BY care_setting;

WITH sle_patients AS (
  SELECT ID, Diagnosis
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%systemic lupus erythematosus%'
     OR Diagnosis = 'SLE'
),
anti_dna AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.Diagnosis, l.DNA,
         CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) AS dna_numeric
  FROM sle_patients AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE l.DNA IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(l.DNA) <> ''
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         MAX(dna_numeric) OVER () AS max_dna
  FROM anti_dna
)
SELECT ID AS patient_identifier,
       Diagnosis AS patient_diagnosis,
       DNA AS highest_anti_DNA_result
FROM ranked
WHERE dna_numeric = max_dna
ORDER BY ID;

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT
    ID,
    RNP,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
  FROM Laboratory
),
parsed AS (
  SELECT
    ID,
    CASE
      WHEN TRIM(RNP) = '' THEN NULL
      WHEN UPPER(TRIM(RNP)) IN ('NEGATIVE', 'NEG', '0') THEN 0
      ELSE CAST(RNP AS REAL)
    END AS rnp_level
  FROM latest
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT CAST(
  SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.SEX)) IN ('F', 'FEMALE') AND x.rnp_level >= 32 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.SEX)) IN ('M', 'MALE') AND x.rnp_level >= 32 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  AS INTEGER
) AS female_minus_male
FROM Patient p
JOIN parsed x ON x.ID = p.ID;

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
  FROM Examination e
  WHERE e.Thrombosis = 1
),
latest_rnp AS (
  SELECT
    l.ID,
    l.Date,
    l.RNP,
    l.CPK,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.ID ORDER BY l.Date DESC) AS rn
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN cohort c ON c.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM latest_rnp lr
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = lr.ID
WHERE lr.rn = 1
  AND p.SEX = 'F'
  AND CAST(lr.RNP AS REAL) > 64
  AND lr.CPK < 250;

WITH confirmed_sle AS (
    SELECT ID, Admission
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
      AND Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%SLE susp%'
      AND Admission IN ('+', '-')
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS eligible_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatients,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatients
    FROM confirmed_sle
)
SELECT
    inpatients,
    outpatients,
    ROUND(100.0 * inpatients / NULLIF(eligible_count, 0), 2) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM counts;

WITH qualifying_ldh AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE LDH >= 500
),
qualifying_protein AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE CASE
    WHEN TRIM("U-PRO") GLOB '>=*[0-9]*'
      THEN CAST(SUBSTR(TRIM("U-PRO"), 3) AS REAL) >= 100
    WHEN TRIM("U-PRO") GLOB '*(*'
      AND TRIM("U-PRO") GLOB '*[0-9]*)*'
      THEN CAST(
        SUBSTR(
          TRIM("U-PRO"),
          INSTR(TRIM("U-PRO"), '(') + 1,
          INSTR(TRIM("U-PRO"), ')') - INSTR(TRIM("U-PRO"), '(') - 1
        ) AS REAL
      ) >= 100
    ELSE 0
  END
)
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN qualifying_ldh AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
JOIN qualifying_protein AS u ON u.ID = p.ID
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Examination e
  WHERE e.ID = p.ID
)
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND "First Date" >= '1998-01-01'
  AND "First Date" < '1999-01-01'
  AND Admission LIKE '+%';

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID AS patient_id,
    p.Birthday,
    p.Diagnosis AS overall_diagnosis,
    e."Examination Date" AS examination_date,
    e.Symptoms AS symptom,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY p.ID
      ORDER BY e."Examination Date" DESC
    ) AS examination_rank
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Examination AS e
    ON e.ID = p.ID
  WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(e.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%SLE%'
    AND LOWER(COALESCE(e.Diagnosis, '')) NOT LIKE '%susp%'
    AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(e.Symptoms) <> ''
)
SELECT
  patient_id,
  overall_diagnosis,
  symptom,
  examination_date
FROM qualifying
WHERE examination_rank = 1
ORDER BY Birthday DESC, patient_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM"), 1) AS average_acl_igm
FROM Examination
WHERE "Examination Date" >= '1993-10-01'
  AND "Examination Date" < '1993-11-01'
  AND Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%';

WITH sexes(sex) AS (
  SELECT 'male'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'female'
)
SELECT s.sex, COUNT(p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM sexes AS s
LEFT JOIN Patient AS p
  ON LOWER(p.SEX) = s.sex
 AND NOT EXISTS (
   SELECT 1
   FROM Laboratory AS l
   WHERE l.ID = p.ID
     AND l.GPT >= 60
 )
GROUP BY s.sex
ORDER BY CASE s.sex WHEN 'male' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE RBC < 3.5
),
patient_ages AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.Admission,
    2026 - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday) > '10-09' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age_years
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN eligible AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
    AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  Admission AS care_setting,
  COUNT(*) AS patient_count,
  ROUND(AVG(age_years), 1) AS average_completed_age
FROM patient_ages
GROUP BY Admission
ORDER BY Admission DESC;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(e."aCL IgM"), 2) AS average_acl_igm
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SJS%'
  AND LOWER(p.Diagnosis) NOT LIKE '%susp%'
  AND e."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL
  AND e."aCL IgM" <> 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS female_patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE LOWER(p.SEX) IN ('female', 'f')
  AND LOWER(e.Diagnosis) LIKE '%sjs%'
  AND LOWER(e.Diagnosis) NOT LIKE '%suspect%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND (LOWER(TRIM(l.RNP)) = 'negative' OR TRIM(l.RNP) = '0')
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l.ID = p.ID
    AND LOWER(TRIM(l.SM)) IN ('negative', '0')
)
AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Examination e
  WHERE e.ID = p.ID
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Examination e
  WHERE e.ID = p.ID
    AND e.Thrombosis = 1
)
AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l.ID = p.ID
    AND TRIM(l.`U-PRO`) NOT IN ('-', 'TR')
    AND CAST(TRIM(l.`U-PRO`) AS REAL) >= 30
);

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT p.ID,
           (julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.2425 AS age_years
    FROM Patient AS p
    WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
      AND julianday('2026-10-09') < julianday(p.Birthday, '+70 years')
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Laboratory AS l
          WHERE l.ID = p.ID
            AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 64
      )
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(age_years), 1) AS average_age_years
FROM eligible;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND p.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND l.WBC > 3.5 AND l.WBC < 9.0
  AND (l.FG <= 150 OR l.FG >= 450)
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 15;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE p.Birthday >= '1936-01-01'
    AND p.Birthday < '1957-01-01'
    AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.CPK >= 250
    )
)
SELECT ROUND(
         100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /
         NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX IN ('F', 'M') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
         1
       ) AS women_percentage
FROM eligible;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.Date >= '1981-01-01'
  AND l.Date < '1987-01-01'
  AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER)
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
    - (strftime('%m-%d', l.Date) < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday))
  ) < 50
  AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
  AND l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(l."U-PRO") <> ''
  AND TRIM(l."U-PRO") NOT IN ('-', '0');

WITH single_bond_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '-'
),
oxygen_counts AS (
  SELECT
    s.molecule_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN a.element = 'O' THEN 1 END) AS oxygen_count
  FROM single_bond_molecules AS s
  LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = s.molecule_id
  GROUP BY s.molecule_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule
FROM oxygen_counts;

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS average_single_bonds_per_molecule
FROM (
  SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS single_bond_count
  FROM bond AS b
  JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '-'
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
);

WITH element_counts AS (
  SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS atom_occurrences
  FROM atom AS a
  JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '-'
  GROUP BY a.element
)
SELECT element, atom_occurrences
FROM element_counts
WHERE atom_occurrences = (SELECT MIN(atom_occurrences) FROM element_counts)
ORDER BY element;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'I' THEN a.atom_id END) AS distinct_iodine_atoms,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'S' THEN a.atom_id END) AS distinct_sulfur_atoms
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond AS b
  ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

WITH bond_counts AS (
    SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM bond
    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
    GROUP BY bond_type
),
most_common AS (
    SELECT bond_type
    FROM bond_counts
    ORDER BY cnt DESC, bond_type
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    (SELECT bond_type FROM most_common) AS bond_type,
    CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS carcinogenic
FROM molecule AS m
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR010';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '#'
    GROUP BY molecule_id
)
AND a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element IN ('P', 'Br')
    GROUP BY molecule_id
);

WITH single_bond_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '-'
),
qualifying_atoms AS (
  SELECT a.element
  FROM atom AS a
  JOIN single_bond_molecules AS s USING (molecule_id)
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
  4
) AS chlorine_percentage
FROM qualifying_atoms;

WITH molecule_groups AS (
  SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM bond b
        WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM bond b
        WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
          AND (b.bond_type IS NULL OR b.bond_type <> '-')
      )
      THEN 'every bond is single'
      ELSE 'not every bond is single'
    END AS bond_group
  FROM molecule m
)
SELECT
  bond_group,
  SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic
FROM molecule_groups
GROUP BY bond_group
ORDER BY bond_group;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS total_carbon_carbon_double_bonds
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id AND a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2 AND a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = '='
  AND a1.element = 'C'
  AND a2.element = 'C';

WITH carcinogenic_cc AS (
  SELECT b.bond_type
  FROM molecule AS m
  JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  WHERE m.label = '+'
    AND a1.element = 'C'
    AND a2.element = 'C'
),
bond_types(bond_type) AS (
  VALUES ('-'), ('='), ('#')
)
SELECT
  CASE bond_types.bond_type
    WHEN '-' THEN 'single'
    WHEN '=' THEN 'double'
    WHEN '#' THEN 'triple'
  END AS bond_type,
  COUNT(carcinogenic_cc.bond_type) AS count
FROM bond_types
LEFT JOIN carcinogenic_cc
  ON carcinogenic_cc.bond_type = bond_types.bond_type
GROUP BY bond_types.bond_type
ORDER BY CASE bond_types.bond_type
  WHEN '-' THEN 1
  WHEN '=' THEN 2
  ELSE 3
END;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN c.atom_id2 WHEN a2.element = 'cl' THEN c.atom_id END) AS count_atoms_bonded_to_chlorine
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS sulfur_atom_bonded_atom_pairs
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS s ON s.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c ON (c.atom_id = s.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = s.atom_id)
JOIN atom AS neighbor
  ON neighbor.atom_id = CASE
    WHEN c.atom_id = s.atom_id THEN c.atom_id2
    ELSE c.atom_id
  END
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND LOWER(s.element) = 's';

SELECT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m
  ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom AS a
    WHERE a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM atom AS other_a
        WHERE other_a.element = a.element
          AND other_a.molecule_id <> b.molecule_id
      )
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT n.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM atom AS n
WHERE n.element = 'n'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom AS n2
    JOIN connected AS c
      ON c.atom_id = n2.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = n2.atom_id
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    WHERE n2.molecule_id = n.molecule_id
      AND n2.element = 'n'
      AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN c.atom_id2 WHEN a2.element = 'cl' THEN c.atom_id END) AS atoms_bonded_to_chlorine
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl';

WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '#'
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_carcinogenic_count
  FROM triple_bond_molecules t
  JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = t.molecule_id
)
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * carcinogenic_count / total_count, 2) AS carcinogenic_percent,
  ROUND(100.0 * non_carcinogenic_count / total_count, 2) AS non_carcinogenic_percent
FROM counts;

WITH rare_elements AS (
  SELECT element
  FROM atom
  GROUP BY element
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1
),
qualifying_atoms AS (
  SELECT a.molecule_id, a.atom_id
  FROM atom AS a
  JOIN rare_elements AS r ON r.element = a.element
),
bond_counts AS (
  SELECT qa.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count
  FROM qualifying_atoms AS qa
  JOIN connected AS c
    ON c.atom_id = qa.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = qa.atom_id
  JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  GROUP BY qa.molecule_id
)
SELECT m.molecule_id, bc.bond_count
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN bond_counts AS bc ON bc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id;

WITH atom_counts AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(element) = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS number_of_carbon_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(element) = 'CL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS number_of_chlorine_atoms
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT
        b.molecule_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS number_of_bonds,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN UPPER(a1.element) = 'C' OR UPPER(a2.element) = 'C' THEN b.bond_id
        END) AS carbon_touching_bonds,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN UPPER(b.bond_type) IN ('DOUBLE', 'TRIPLE', '=', '#', '2', '3') THEN b.bond_id
        END) AS multiple_bonds
    FROM bond AS b
    LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    LEFT JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    LEFT JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        m.molecule_id,
        m.label AS carcinogenicity_label,
        ac.number_of_atoms,
        COALESCE(bc.number_of_bonds, 0) AS number_of_bonds,
        ac.number_of_carbon_atoms,
        ac.number_of_chlorine_atoms,
        COALESCE(bc.carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS carbon_touching_bonds,
        COALESCE(bc.multiple_bonds, 0) AS multiple_bonds,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY COALESCE(bc.carbon_touching_bonds, 0) DESC,
                     ac.number_of_atoms DESC,
                     m.molecule_id ASC
        ) AS rank_position
    FROM molecule AS m
    JOIN atom_counts AS ac ON ac.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN bond_counts AS bc ON bc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE ac.number_of_carbon_atoms > 0
)
SELECT
    rank_position,
    molecule_id,
    carcinogenicity_label,
    number_of_atoms,
    number_of_bonds,
    number_of_carbon_atoms,
    number_of_chlorine_atoms,
    carbon_touching_bonds,
    multiple_bonds
FROM ranked
ORDER BY rank_position;

SELECT b.bond_type AS bond_kind_symbol, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a1.element || '|' || a2.element ELSE a2.element || '|' || a1.element END) AS element_pair_count, m.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR377' AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY bond_count DESC, bond_kind_symbol ASC;

WITH atom_bond_types AS (
  SELECT a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type
  FROM atom AS a
  JOIN connected AS c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
  JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id

  UNION ALL

  SELECT a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type
  FROM atom AS a
  JOIN connected AS c ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
  JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
),
atom_status AS (
  SELECT
    atom_id,
    element,
    COUNT(*) AS bond_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS non_single_count
  FROM atom_bond_types
  GROUP BY atom_id, element
)
SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom_status
WHERE bond_count > 0
  AND non_single_count = 0
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element;

SELECT a.element, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond AS b
  ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
 AND b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, a.element ASC;

SELECT a.element, COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR397'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
  )
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element;
